definition_zh: 一排；一列；划船；划船游览；连续的一段时期
definition_en: a line of people or things, to move a boat using oars, or a continuous period of something
core_image: 一排首尾对齐的东西，或一支桨把船推向前的整齐动作
scene: 教室里的课桌一排排摆得整整齐齐。The students sat in the front row of the classroom.
sceneCN: 这里 row 是「一排」（第 1 个义项：首尾对齐排列的一行人或物）；句意：学生们坐在教室的前排。

pos.zh: 一排；一列；划船；（连续的）一段时间
划船；划船运送；使成排

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 后缀构成，指划船的人
由动词加 -ing 转名词，义为「划船运动」

senses.title: A line of people or things
senses.definition: a line of people or things arranged side by side
senses.definitionCN: 人或物首尾对齐排成的一行
senses.example: There is a row of old houses along the street.
senses.exampleCN: 沿街有一排老房子。
senses.why: Things placed side by side form a straight line, which is the oldest image of the word.
senses.whyCN: 东西肩并肩排开就形成一条直线，这是这个词最古老直观的画面。

senses.title: To move a boat with oars
senses.definition: to make a boat move forward using oars
senses.definitionCN: 用桨使船前进
senses.example: We rowed across the quiet lake in the morning.
senses.exampleCN: 早晨我们划船横渡宁静的湖面。
senses.why: The oars are fixed in a straight line on both sides of the boat, like a row of sticks pulling together.
senses.whyCN: 桨在船舷两侧排成整齐的一列，像一排木棍合力把船推向前，与「排」的画面相通。

senses.title: A trip in a rowing boat
senses.definition: a short journey made in a boat that is moved with oars
senses.definitionCN: 乘划桨小船做的一次短途出游
senses.example: We went for a row on the river yesterday.
senses.exampleCN: 昨天我们去河上划船游玩。
senses.why: Once the action is named, the whole trip made by that action takes the same word.
senses.whyCN: 动作有了名字，靠这个动作完成的一次出游也就顺理成章叫同一个词。

senses.title: A continuous period
senses.titleCN: 连续的一段时期（in a row）
senses.definition: a series of things happening one after another without a break, used in the phrase in a row
senses.definitionCN: 在短语 in a row 中表示事情一个接一个连续发生
senses.example: He was late for work three days in a row.
senses.exampleCN: 他连续三天上班迟到。
senses.why: Things arranged in one line follow one another without gaps, so the line image extends to time.
senses.whyCN: 排成一列的东西首尾相接、中间无空隙，直线的画面由此延伸到时间上的连续。

intro.en: Row comes from Old English raw, meaning a line or a series of things.
intro.cn: row 源自古英语 raw，意为一条线或一列东西。

items.en: The reconstructed Germanic root *raig- is thought to mean a line or stripe.
items.cn: 一般认为重构的日耳曼语词根 *raig- 意为线条或条纹，是 row 的共同源头。

items.en: Raw in Old English already meant a line or series of things.
items.cn: 古英语 raw 已指一列、一排东西，排列义从一开始就存在。

items.en: Row keeps the line sense in both people and objects.
items.cn: 中古英语时期 row 保留排列义，既指人排也指物排。

items.en: The boat sense comes from a different Old English word rothat, related to pulling oars.
items.cn: 划船义一般认为来自另一个古英语词源（与操桨有关），与排列义同形而来源不同，属同形异源词。

items.en: In a row extends the line image to repeated events in time.
items.cn: 短语 in a row 把排成一列的画面延伸到时间上接连发生的事。

note.en: Row has look-alike words with different sources and near-meaning words about lines and boats.
note.cn: row 的形近词多属同形异源，近义词集中在排列与划船的义场。

entries.definition: not cooked; in a natural state
entries.definitionCN: 生的；未加工的，与 row 只差一个字母，词源无关，仅拼写相近

entries.definition: to bend the head forward; the front of a ship
entries.definitionCN: 鞠躬；船头，与 row 韵母相同、拼写相近，但词源不同，只是形近

entries.definition: noisy and disorderly
entries.definitionCN: 吵闹的；粗暴的，词首拼法相同但重音与词源均不同，属形近词

entries.definition: a row of people or things; a long mark
entries.definitionCN: 一排；行列；线，泛指一切线性排列，不限于首尾对齐的实物

entries.definition: a line of people or things arranged one behind another
entries.definitionCN: 纵列；柱，与 row 横排相对，指前后相接的竖列

entries.definition: to move a small boat with a wide flat oar held by hand
entries.definitionCN: 用短桨划（小船），桨不固定在船舷，动作方式与 row 不同

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember row through lines and oars.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕排列与船桨的记忆路径。

normal.en: ROW looks like three things standing shoulder to shoulder: r-o-w.
normal.cn: ROW 三个字母肩并肩站成一排，本身就是「一排」的样子。

normal.en: A ROW of corn in a field: farmers plant corn in straight lines.
normal.cn: 田里一垄一垄的玉米，农民种玉米就是种成整齐的一排排。

normal.en: ROW a boat: the two oars pull the boat in a straight line forward.
normal.cn: 划船时两支桨一左一右排开，把船沿直线推向前进。

normal.en: Cinema ROW: seat numbers go A1, A2, A3 in one long line.
normal.cn: 电影院的一排座位，A1、A2、A3 连成一条长线。

normal.en: Three days IN A ROW means one day right behind another, like chairs in a line.
normal.cn: in a row 表示一天紧接一天，就像椅子首尾相接排成一行。

abstract.en: Picture a straight chalk line drawn through a row of desks.
abstract.cn: 想象一条粉笔线笔直地穿过一排课桌。

abstract.en: Feel the oars dip in rhythm, one pull at a time, a line of strokes.
abstract.cn: 感受双桨有节奏地入水，一下一下连成一条拉桨的直线。

abstract.en: See days lined up like railway carriages, one after another in a row.
abstract.cn: 把日子想象成一节节首尾相接的车厢，排成一列开过去。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to move to the front row.
examples.cn: 老师让我们挪到前排去。

examples.en: They rowed the boat to the far side of the lake.
examples.cn: 他们把船划到湖的对岸。

examples.en: Our team won five matches in a row.
examples.cn: 我们队连续赢了五场比赛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「肉排」——一排排骨整齐码开；row 读音近似「肉」，一排排东西就像码好的肉排

root: 排列义一般认为源自日耳曼语词根 *raig-（线条），古英语 raw 直承此义；划船义属同形异源，来自古英语另一个与操桨相关的词形，两词在现代英语中合流同形。

sensesIntro.en: Row moves from a line of things to the straight pull of oars, then to a boat trip and repeated events.
sensesIntro.cn: row 从一列东西出发，延伸到船桨的整齐划动，再到划船出游与接连发生的事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: things lined up straight, side by side
core.cn: 核心意象：东西首尾对齐排成的一条直线

branches.en: People or objects placed side by side form the basic line.
branches.cn: 人或物肩并肩排开，构成最基本的一排。

branches.en: Oars fixed on both sides of a boat stand in a line like a row of sticks.
branches.cn: 固定在船舷两侧的桨排成一列，正像一排木棍。

branches.en: The action of rowing names the whole trip made by that action.
branches.cn: 划桨这个动作的名字顺势指代靠它完成的一次出游。

branches.en: A line has no gaps, so events in a row follow one another directly.
branches.cn: 直线中间没有空隙，in a row 里的时间也因此接连不断。

branches.en: Seats in a cinema and days in a row share the same straight-line image.
branches.cn: 影院的一排座位与连续的几天共享同一条直线的意象。

intro.en: Row forms compounds around its line shape and boat use.
intro.cn: row 的构词围绕直线排列与划船两条线索展开。

latinIntro.en: Row is a Germanic word without Latin relatives, so no Latin entries are listed.
latinIntro.cn: row 属日耳曼语源词，没有拉丁同族词，故不列拉丁词条。

items.meaning: the line of seats nearest the stage
items.meaningCN: 前排；最靠近舞台或场地的一排座位
items.example: They bought front row seats for the concert.
items.exampleCN: 他们买了这场音乐会的前排座位。

items.meaning: a house joined to others in a continuous line
items.meaningCN: 排屋；连成一排的联立房屋
items.example: The street is lined with red brick row houses.
items.exampleCN: 这条街两侧是红砖排屋。

items.meaning: a small boat moved with oars
items.example: We rented a rowing boat by the lake.
items.exampleCN: 我们在湖边租了一条划艇。

items.meaning: one after another without a break
items.example: She wore the same coat five days in a row.
items.exampleCN: 她连续五天穿同一件外套。

items.meaning: to make a loud noise in protest
items.meaningCN: 大吵大闹；起哄（此处 row 为另一同形词，读 /raʊ/，指吵嚷）
items.example: The neighbours kicked up a row about the noise.
items.exampleCN: 邻居们为噪音大吵大闹。

items.meaning: a person who rows a boat
items.example: Each rower pulls hard on the oars.
items.exampleCN: 每名桨手都用力划桨。

items.meaning: the sport of moving boats with oars
items.example: Rowing is popular on this river.
items.exampleCN: 划船运动在这条河上很流行。

items.meaning: the part of a prison for prisoners waiting execution
items.meaningCN: 死囚区；关押待决死刑犯的监区
items.example: The novel is set on death row.
items.exampleCN: 这部小说以死囚区为背景。

items.meaning: a line of chairs side by side
items.example: A whole row of seats was empty.
items.exampleCN: 整整一排座位都空着。

items.meaning: a poor area of a city where homeless people live
items.meaningCN: 贫民街；流浪者聚集的城市街区
items.example: He ended up living on skid row.
items.exampleCN: 他最后沦落到贫民街栖身。

definition_zh: 王室的；皇家的；盛大的；王室成员
definition_en: belonging to or connected with a king or queen, or a member of a royal family
core_image: 王冠下的家族：一切属于国王与王后的人与物
scene: 王宫前举行了盛大的阅兵仪式，士兵们列队走过。The royal family waved to the crowd from the palace balcony.
sceneCN: 这里 royal 是「王室的」（第 1 个义项：属于国王或女王及其家族）；句意：王室成员在王宫阳台上向人群挥手。

pos.zh: 王室的；皇家的；盛大的；庄严的
王室成员

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加 -ty 后缀构成，义为「王室成员；版税」
由形容词加 -ly 后缀构成，义为「盛大地；庄严地」
与 royal 仅字母顺序不同，义为「忠诚的」，词源不同，属形近词

senses.title: Belonging to a king or queen
senses.definition: connected with or belonging to the king or queen of a country
senses.definitionCN: 与国王、女王或其家族相关或为其所有
senses.example: The royal family lives in a grand palace.
senses.exampleCN: 王室家族住在一座宏伟的宫殿里。
senses.why: The crown marks everything that belongs to the ruler, so the word points straight at the throne.
senses.whyCN: 王冠是统治者的标志，凡属君主与王族的都冠以这个词，直指王座。

senses.title: Founded or named by a monarch
senses.titleCN: 由君主敕建的；冠以 royal 之名的
senses.definition: given the name royal by a king or queen, often for an organization they support
senses.definitionCN: 由国王或女王授予 royal 称号的组织或机构
senses.example: She is a member of the Royal Society of Science.
senses.exampleCN: 她是皇家科学学会的成员。
senses.why: Monarchs grant their title to institutions as a mark of patronage, extending the crown's reach.
senses.whyCN: 君主把 royal 称号赐给受其庇护的机构，王冠的权威由此延伸到这些组织。

senses.title: Grand and splendid
senses.definition: very grand, impressive, or magnificent in appearance
senses.definitionCN: 外观上极为宏大、气派、令人印象深刻
senses.example: They gave us a royal welcome at the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在门口给了我们盛大的欢迎。
senses.why: Everything the crown touches is expected to be splendid, so royal stretches to any magnificence.
senses.whyCN: 王冠所及之物都须气派非凡，royal 由此引申为一切盛大恢宏的场面。

senses.title: A member of the royal family
senses.definition: a person who belongs to a royal family, used as a noun
senses.definitionCN: 作名词用，指王族中的一员
senses.example: Crowds gathered to see the young royal at the station.
senses.exampleCN: 人群聚集在车站迎接这位年轻的王室成员。
senses.why: An adjective for the family becomes a noun for any person inside that family.
senses.whyCN: 形容家族的词顺势转指家族中的任何一个人。

intro.en: Royal comes through Old French from Latin regalis, meaning of a king, from rex, king.
intro.cn: royal 经古法语来自拉丁语 regalis（君王的），词根为 rex（国王）。

items.en: Regalis means of or belonging to a king, built on rex, the Latin word for king.
items.cn: 拉丁语 regalis 意为「属于国王的」，建立在 rex（国王）一词之上。

items.en: Old French kept the word as roial, carrying the same royal meaning.
items.cn: 古法语将该词承袭为 roial，王家的意义未变。

items.en: Royal entered English in the thirteenth century, competing with native kingly.
items.cn: royal 于十三世纪进入英语，与本族词 kingly 并存并用。

items.en: English monarchs began granting the title royal to institutions and ships.
items.cn: 英国君主开始把 royal 称号授予机构与舰船，扩大了该词的使用范围。

items.en: Royal now covers the family, its institutions, and any splendid occasion.
items.cn: 今天 royal 覆盖王室家族、其所属机构，以及一切盛大庄严的场合。

note.en: Royal has a famous look-alike with swapped letters and near-meaning words about monarchy.
note.cn: royal 有一个字母换位的著名形近词，近义词集中在君主题材的义场。

entries.definition: faithful to a person, country, or idea
entries.definitionCN: 忠诚的，与 royal 仅字母顺序互换，读音几乎相同但词源无关，属经典形近词

entries.definition: fitting for a king; splendid and dignified
entries.definitionCN: 帝王气派的；庄严华丽的，与 royal 同出拉丁语 rex，更侧重气质而非身份

entries.definition: actually existing; not imagined
entries.definitionCN: 真实的；实在的，与 royal 拼写仅差一字母，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: suitable for or like a king
entries.definitionCN: 国王般的；威严的，本族语说法，强调气质而不强调隶属关系

entries.definition: grand and impressive in appearance or manner
entries.definitionCN: 雄伟的；威严的，突出气势恢宏，不必与王族相关

entries.definition: related to an emperor or empire
entries.definitionCN: 帝国的；皇帝的，规模与级别高于国王，常用于帝国语境

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember royal through the crown and its Latin root.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕王冠与其拉丁词根的记忆路径。

normal.en: ROYAL contains ROY, from Latin rex meaning king: the king's word.
normal.cn: ROYAL 里的 ROY 来自拉丁语 rex（国王），这个词本来就是「国王的」。

normal.en: ROYAL vs LOYAL: swap two letters and the crown becomes a promise.
normal.cn: ROYAL 与 LOYAL 互换两个字母，王冠就变成了忠诚的誓言，正巧王室最需要忠诚。

normal.en: The Royal Navy sails with the crown painted on its ships.
normal.cn: 皇家海军的舰船上画着王冠，royal 一词随王冠出海。

normal.en: REGAL and ROYAL are cousins: both grow from Latin rex.
normal.cn: REGAL 与 ROYAL 是同根兄弟，都长自拉丁语 rex（国王）。

normal.en: A royal welcome rolls out the red carpet, as grand as any palace.
normal.cn: royal welcome 铺开红地毯，排场比得上王宫大典。

abstract.en: Picture a golden crown floating above everything it owns.
abstract.cn: 想象一顶金冠悬浮在它所拥有的一切之上。

abstract.en: Hear trumpets announce a splendid procession entering the gate.
abstract.cn: 听号角齐鸣，盛大仪仗浩浩荡荡走进大门。

abstract.en: See a family tree with a crown at the very top.
abstract.cn: 看一棵家谱树，树顶端端正正放着一顶王冠。

examples.en: The royal palace opens to visitors every summer.
examples.cn: 王宫每年夏天向游客开放。

examples.en: She received a royal welcome when she returned home.
examples.cn: 她回乡时受到了盛大的欢迎。

examples.en: Thousands waited to catch a glimpse of the royals.
examples.cn: 数千人等候一睹王室成员的风采。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「若爱哦」——王室若爱民，民众自然拥戴；royal 读音近似「若爱哦」

root: 源自拉丁语 rex（国王）的派生形容词 regalis（君王的），经古法语 roial 于十三世纪进入英语；与 regal 同根，与 loyal 仅拼写相近而词源无关。

sensesIntro.en: Royal moves from belonging to the crown, to institutions it names, to any splendid grandeur, and finally to the people themselves.
sensesIntro.cn: royal 从「属于王冠」出发，扩展到受封的组织、盛大排场，最后转指王室成员本人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: everything under the golden crown
core.cn: 核心意象：金冠之下的一切人与物

branches.en: The crown marks the king, the queen, and all who belong to them.
branches.cn: 王冠标记国王、女王以及所有属于他们的人。

branches.en: Monarchs lend the crown's name to institutions they protect.
branches.cn: 君主把王冠之名借给它所庇护的机构。

branches.en: What the crown touches must look magnificent.
branches.cn: 王冠所及之物必须气派非凡。

branches.en: The adjective for the family turns into a noun for its members.
branches.cn: 形容家族的形容词转指家族中的成员。

branches.en: A titled society and a grand feast both borrow the crown's splendor.
branches.cn: 受封的学会与盛大的宴席都在借用王冠的光彩。

intro.en: Royal builds a small family around the Latin root for king.
intro.cn: royal 围绕拉丁语「国王」词根构成一个小小的词族。

latinIntro.en: Royal comes from Latin regalis, built on rex, so it has close Latin-rooted relatives.
latinIntro.cn: royal 来自拉丁语 regalis（建立在 rex 之上），故有拉丁同根近亲。

items.meaning: members of a royal family; a payment for each copy of a book sold
items.meaningCN: 王室成员（总称）；版税（按销量付给作者的费用）
items.example: The writer earns a royalty on every copy sold.
items.exampleCN: 每卖出一本书，作者都能拿到版税。

items.meaning: in a grand or splendid way
items.example: We were royally entertained at the banquet.
items.exampleCN: 宴会上我们受到了盛大的款待。

items.meaningCN: 帝王气派的；庄严的（与 royal 同根的更文学说法）
items.example: She made a regal entrance in a long gown.
items.exampleCN: 她身穿长裙、仪态庄严地入场。

items.meaning: the crown, scepter, and other emblems of royalty
items.meaningCN: 王权的标志物（王冠、权杖等）
items.example: The coronation displayed the ancient regalia.
items.exampleCN: 加冕典礼上陈列了古老的王权标志物。

items.meaningCN: 国王（拉丁语名词，整个词族的源头）
items.example: Rex appears in the Latin title of a king.
items.exampleCN: rex 出现在国王的拉丁语头衔中。

items.meaning: a ruler acting for a sovereign in a colony
items.meaningCN: 总督；代替君主统治殖民地的官员
items.example: The viceroy governed the colony for the king.
items.exampleCN: 总督代国王治理殖民地。

items.meaning: a supporter of a king or queen
items.example: Royalists gathered to defend the palace.
items.exampleCN: 保皇派聚集起来保卫王宫。

items.meaning: the king or queen and their relatives
items.example: The royal family appears on the balcony each year.
items.exampleCN: 王室家族每年都在阳台上亮相。

items.meaning: an order made by a monarch
items.meaningCN: 敕令；由君主颁布的法令
items.example: A royal decree established the new order.
items.exampleCN: 一道敕令确立了新秩序。

items.meaning: the highest hand in the card game of poker
items.meaningCN: 同花大顺（扑克牌中最大的牌型）
items.example: He won the game with a royal flush.
items.exampleCN: 他靠同花大顺赢了这局牌。

latinEntries.meaning: of or belonging to a king
latinEntries.meaningCN: 君王的；属于国王的（royal 的直接来源）

definition_zh: 擦；摩擦；揉；擦痕；困难（the rub）
definition_en: to press something against a surface and move it back and forth, or a mark made by rubbing
core_image: 两只手掌来回搓动：压力加上往返移动
scene: 冬天手冷，他不停地搓着双手取暖。He rubbed his hands together to keep warm in the cold wind.
sceneCN: 这里 rub 是「摩擦」（第 1 个义项：压住并在表面来回移动）；句意：寒风中他搓着双手取暖。

pos.zh: 擦；摩擦；揉；蹭
摩擦；擦痕；障碍；困难

collocations.zh: 往伤口上撒盐；雪上加霜

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 后缀构成，指擦除之物（橡皮）或摩擦产生的材料（橡胶）
一般认为与 rub 同族词形相关，义为「垃圾；废物；胡说」
由 rubbish 加 -y 后缀构成，义为「无价值的；劣质的」

senses.title: To press and move against a surface
senses.definition: to press one thing against a surface and move it backwards and forwards
senses.definitionCN: 把一物压在表面上并来回移动
senses.example: He rubbed his hands together to keep warm.
senses.exampleCN: 他搓着双手取暖。
senses.why: Pressure plus repeated movement is the physical core of the word.
senses.whyCN: 压力加往返移动，是这个词最根本的物理画面。

senses.title: To cause pain or damage by friction
senses.definition: to make skin sore by repeated rubbing
senses.definitionCN: 因反复摩擦使皮肤疼痛或破损
senses.example: The new shoes rubbed my heels badly.
senses.exampleCN: 这双新鞋把我的脚后跟磨得很疼。
senses.why: The same back-and-forth movement harms skin when it repeats too long.
senses.whyCN: 同一种往返动作持续太久，就反过来伤害皮肤。

senses.title: A mark left by rubbing
senses.definition: a dark mark or damage left on a surface by rubbing
senses.definitionCN: 摩擦在表面留下的黑色印记或损伤
senses.example: There is a black rub on the car door.
senses.exampleCN: 车门上有一道黑色的擦痕。
senses.why: The action leaves its trace, so the mark takes the same name.
senses.whyCN: 动作会留下痕迹，痕迹便沿用了动作的名字。

senses.title: The difficulty in a situation
senses.definition: the part of a situation that causes problems, used in the phrase the rub is that
senses.definitionCN: 在短语 the rub is that 中指事情里造成麻烦的部分
senses.example: The plan sounds fine; the rub is that we lack money.
senses.exampleCN: 计划听上去不错，问题在于我们没有钱。
senses.why: Friction is what blocks smooth movement, so rubbing names whatever blocks a plan.
senses.whyCN: 摩擦正是阻碍顺滑移动的东西，于是「擦」借指一切卡住计划的障碍。

intro.en: Rub is of uncertain origin; it appeared in Middle English and may be connected with Low German rubben.
intro.cn: rub 词源不确定，见于中古英语，一般认为可能与低地德语 rubben（摩擦）相关。

items.en: Rubben in Low German means to rub, a possible source, though the link is not proven.
items.cn: 低地德语 rubben 意为摩擦，可能是来源之一，但关联尚未确证。

items.en: Rub appears in English in the fourteenth century, already meaning to rub and to scour.
items.cn: 十四世纪 rub 已在英语中出现，兼指摩擦与擦拭。

items.en: Shakespeare popularized the noun sense of difficulty in Hamlet: there's the rub.
items.cn: 莎士比亚在《哈姆雷特》中让名词「症结」义广为流传：there's the rub（难就难在这里）。

items.en: Rubber names the material that rubs out pencil marks, giving both eraser and the elastic substance.
items.cn: rubber 因能擦去铅笔字而得名称「擦除之物」，后兼指弹性材料橡胶。

items.en: Rub extends to idioms about social contact and adding insult to injury.
items.cn: 现代英语中 rub 扩展出社交接触与雪上加霜等习语用法。

note.en: Rub has look-alike family words and near-meaning words about friction and wiping.
note.cn: rub 的形近词多属同族，近义词集中在摩擦与擦拭的义场。

entries.definition: an eraser; the elastic material made from tree sap
entries.definitionCN: 橡皮；橡胶，由 rub 加 -er 构成，因「擦除」功能得名

entries.definition: things thrown away; nonsense
entries.definitionCN: 垃圾；废物；胡说，与 rub 族词形相关，强调被磨掉、被弃之物

entries.definition: one of the curved bones protecting the chest
entries.definitionCN: 肋骨，与 rub 仅一字母之差且常谐音联想，但词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: to clean something by hard rubbing with a brush
entries.definitionCN: 用力擦洗；刷洗，强调用刷子彻底清洁，比 rub 更用力

entries.definition: to clean a surface by passing a cloth over it
entries.definitionCN: 擦拭；抹，动作轻于 rub，只需一两次划过

entries.definition: to make a surface smooth and shiny by rubbing
entries.definitionCN: 抛光；擦亮，目的在于使表面光亮，rub 只是手段

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember rub through pressure and movement.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕压力与往返移动的记忆路径。

normal.en: RUB your hands on a cold day: rub-a-dub, back and forth.
normal.cn: 冷天搓手：rub-a-dub，来回搓动的节奏就是这个词的声音。

normal.en: A RUBBER rubs out pencil marks: the tool carries the action in its name.
normal.cn: 橡皮（rubber）擦掉铅笔字，工具的名字里就装着这个动作。

normal.en: RUB shoulders with means to bump elbows with people, just like rubbing.
normal.cn: rub shoulders with 是与人擦肩交往，肩与肩相触正像摩擦。

normal.en: There's the RUB: Shakespeare's line for the snag in the plan.
normal.cn: there's the rub 是莎士比亚的名句，指计划中的绊脚石。

normal.en: RUB salt into the wound: rubbing makes everything hurt more.
normal.cn: 往伤口上撒盐（rub salt into the wound）：摩擦只会让痛更痛。

abstract.en: Feel two palms warm each other by moving back and forth.
abstract.cn: 感受两只手掌来回搓动、互相取暖。

abstract.en: See a pencil mark fade away under an eraser's repeated strokes.
abstract.cn: 看铅笔字在橡皮的一次次擦拭中渐渐消失。

abstract.en: Picture a stone blocking the path: the rub that stops the journey.
abstract.cn: 想象挡在路上的一块石头：那就是让行程卡住的「症结」。

examples.en: She rubbed the stain with a wet cloth.
examples.cn: 她用湿布擦拭那块污渍。

examples.en: These new shoes rub my heels terribly.
examples.cn: 这双新鞋把我的脚跟磨得够呛。

examples.en: The plan is good, but the rub is the cost.
examples.cn: 计划不错，但问题就出在成本上。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拉布」——擦桌子时来回拉扯抹布；rub 读音近似「拉布」

root: 词源不确定，一般认为可能与低地德语 rubben（摩擦）相关，中古英语时期已通用；名词「症结」义由摩擦阻碍移动的意象引申而来。

sensesIntro.en: Rub moves from pressing and moving on a surface, to soreness, to the mark left behind, and finally to whatever blocks a plan.
sensesIntro.cn: rub 从「压住来回移动」出发，引申到磨痛、擦痕，最后借指一切卡住事情的障碍。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: pressure plus back-and-forth movement
core.cn: 核心意象：压住表面来回移动

branches.en: Two surfaces pressed together and moved make friction.
branches.cn: 两个表面压在一起来回移动，产生摩擦。

branches.en: The same movement soothes when brief and harms when repeated.
branches.cn: 同一种动作，短暂是安抚，反复太久就磨伤。

branches.en: Rubbing leaves its trace on the surface it works on.
branches.cn: 摩擦在作用过的表面留下自己的痕迹。

branches.en: Friction blocks smooth motion, so rub names the snag in any plan.
branches.cn: 摩擦阻碍顺畅移动，rub 顺势指代计划中的绊脚石。

branches.en: Erasing a mistake and meeting famous people both borrow the rubbing image.
branches.cn: 擦掉错误与和名人擦肩交往，都借用了摩擦的画面。

intro.en: Rub builds a family of erasing, waste, and friction words.
intro.cn: rub 的词族围绕擦除、废物与摩擦展开。

latinIntro.en: Rub is likely Germanic in origin, so it has no Latin relatives.
latinIntro.cn: rub 一般认为属日耳曼语源，没有拉丁同族词。

items.meaning: an eraser; the elastic material from tree sap
items.meaningCN: 橡皮；橡胶（因擦除功能得名，后指弹性材料）
items.example: Can I borrow your rubber?
items.exampleCN: 能借用一下你的橡皮吗？

items.example: Take out the rubbish before you leave.
items.exampleCN: 走之前把垃圾拿出去。

items.example: Put the peel in the rubbish bin.
items.exampleCN: 把果皮扔进垃圾桶。

items.meaningCN: 用力擦洗（与 rub 同族的强化形式）
items.example: She scrubbed the floor until it shone.
items.exampleCN: 她把地板擦得发亮。

items.example: He rubbed out the wrong answer.
items.exampleCN: 他把写错的答案擦掉了。

items.meaning: to come off by rubbing; to pass on to others
items.meaningCN: 被擦掉；（品质）感染给他人
items.example: His enthusiasm rubbed off on the team.
items.exampleCN: 他的热情感染了整个团队。

items.meaning: to meet and mix with people
items.example: She rubbed shoulders with film stars at the party.
items.exampleCN: 她在聚会上与电影明星们交往。

items.meaningCN: 反复揭人短处；哪壶不开提哪壶
items.example: I lost once; stop rubbing it in.
items.exampleCN: 我就输了一次，别再翻旧账了。

items.meaningCN: 用力擦拭；（运动员的）按摩放松
items.example: The athlete had a rub-down after training.
items.exampleCN: 运动员训练后做了按摩放松。

items.meaning: the hidden difficulty in a situation
items.meaningCN: 症结；难点（固定短语 the rub）
items.example: There's the rub: time is too short.
items.exampleCN: 难就难在这里：时间太短。

definition_zh: 橡胶；橡皮；合成橡胶制品；（英，复数）橡胶雨鞋
definition_en: an elastic material made from tree sap or made artificially, or a small block used to rub out pencil marks
core_image: 一块能弹回原形、能把铅笔字擦掉的软材料
scene: 写错字时他用橡皮轻轻一擦就干净了。He erased the wrong word with his rubber.
sceneCN: 这里 rubber 是「橡皮」（第 2 个义项：擦去铅笔字的小块工具）；句意：他用橡皮把写错的词擦掉了。

pos.zh: 橡胶；橡皮；合成橡胶制品
橡胶制成的

derivatives.zh: 由 rubber 加 -y 后缀构成，义为「似橡胶的；有弹性的」
由 rubber 加 -y 后缀构成，义为「橡胶般的；坚韧而有弹性的」

senses.title: The elastic material
senses.definition: a strong elastic substance made from the sap of tropical trees or produced artificially
senses.definitionCN: 取自热带树汁或人工合成的弹性材料
senses.example: Tires are made of rubber.
senses.exampleCN: 轮胎是用橡胶做的。
senses.why: The material is named for what people did with it: rubbing away pencil marks and rubbing it into shapes.
senses.whyCN: 这种材料因人们的「擦拭」与「揉搓」用法而得名，动作名转指材料本身。

senses.title: A block for erasing
senses.definition: a small block used to remove pencil marks, the usual word in British English
senses.definitionCN: 擦去铅笔字迹的小块工具，英式英语常用词
senses.example: She cleaned the page with a rubber.
senses.exampleCN: 她用橡皮把页面擦干净。
senses.why: The thing is named by the verb: it exists to rub, so it is called a rubber.
senses.whyCN: 这种工具以动词命名：它生来就是用来擦的，故称 rubber。

senses.title: Made of rubber
senses.definition: made of rubber, used before a noun
senses.definitionCN: 作定语，指由橡胶制成的
senses.example: She put on a pair of rubber boots in the rain.
senses.exampleCN: 下雨天她穿上了一双橡胶雨靴。
senses.why: A material name easily becomes an adjective for anything made of that material.
senses.whyCN: 材料名很容易转作定语，标记一切由该材料制成的物件。

senses.title: Rubber footwear
senses.definition: shoes made of rubber worn to keep the feet dry, used in the plural in American English
senses.definitionCN: 美式英语中用复数形式，指橡胶套鞋或雨鞋
senses.example: He pulled on his rubbers before walking through the snow.
senses.exampleCN: 他在踏雪之前套上了橡胶套鞋。
senses.why: Once the adjective exists, the object made of it takes the plural material name.
senses.whyCN: 形容词确立之后，由它制成的鞋物便直接以复数材料名相称。

intro.en: Rubber comes from the verb rub plus the agent suffix -er: the thing that rubs.
intro.cn: rubber 由动词 rub 加施动后缀 -er 构成，意为「用来擦的东西」。

items.en: Rub plus -er first meant a person or tool that rubs or polishes.
items.cn: rub 加 -er 最初指摩擦或抛光的人或工具。

items.en: The word was applied to the new elastic substance because it rubbed out pencil marks.
items.cn: 十八世纪，这种来自南美的弹性材料因能擦去铅笔字而被称作 rubber。

items.en: Vulcanization made rubber durable, and the material spread into tires, boots, and gloves.
items.cn: 硫化工艺使橡胶经久耐用，材料随之进入轮胎、雨靴与手套等制品。

items.en: In America rubber keeps the material sense, while eraser is preferred for the block.
items.cn: 美式英语中 rubber 保留材料义，橡皮擦则更常说 eraser。

items.en: In Britain rubber remains the standard word for the eraser.
items.cn: 英式英语中 rubber 仍是橡皮擦的标准说法。

note.en: Rubber has look-alike family words and near-meaning words about elastic materials and erasing.
note.cn: rubber 的形近词多属同族，近义词集中在弹性材料与擦除的义场。

entries.definition: to press and move against a surface
entries.definitionCN: 擦；摩擦，rubber 的直接词源动词，但作为不同词条不得混用

entries.definition: things thrown away; nonsense
entries.definitionCN: 垃圾；胡说，与 rubber 同族且仅差两字母，需靠语境区分

entries.definition: a small red-breasted bird
entries.definitionCN: 知更鸟，拼写与 rubber 部分相同，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: a small object used to remove pencil marks
entries.definitionCN: 橡皮擦，美式英语的常用说法，与英式 rubber 相对

entries.definition: a material or band that stretches and returns to its shape
entries.definitionCN: 松紧带；有弹性的，强调拉伸回弹性能，不特指橡胶材料

entries.definition: a milky fluid from trees used to make natural rubber
entries.definitionCN: 胶乳；树乳，天然橡胶的原料形态

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember rubber through rubbing and bouncing.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕擦除与弹性的记忆路径。

normal.en: RUBBER = RUB + ER: the thing that rubs out your mistakes.
normal.cn: RUBBER 就是 RUB（擦）加 ER（者）——擦掉错误的那件东西。

normal.en: A rubber ball bounces because rubber springs back to its shape.
normal.cn: 橡胶球能弹起来，正因为橡胶能回弹复原。

normal.en: Rubber BAND stretches around a pile of papers and snaps back.
normal.cn: 橡皮筋（rubber band）绷住一叠纸，一松手又弹回去。

normal.en: British students keep a RUBBER in their pencil case; American students call it an eraser.
normal.cn: 英国学生笔袋里放 rubber，美国学生叫它 eraser，同一块橡皮两种叫法。

normal.en: Rubber boots keep your feet dry in the rain: the material repels water.
normal.cn: 橡胶雨靴让双脚在雨中保持干爽，这种材料天生防水。

abstract.en: Picture a pencil mark vanishing under a small pink block.
abstract.cn: 想象铅笔字在一小块粉色橡皮下渐渐消失。

abstract.en: Feel a rubber band stretch wider and wider before it snaps back.
abstract.cn: 感受橡皮筋越拉越长，随后猛地弹回。

abstract.en: See a tire gripping the wet road, bending and recovering with every turn.
abstract.cn: 看轮胎紧咬湿滑路面，每一圈转动都在弯曲又复原。

examples.en: The tires of the truck are made of thick rubber.
examples.cn: 卡车的轮胎由厚实的橡胶制成。

examples.en: Hand me the rubber so I can fix this mistake.
examples.cn: 把橡皮递给我，我要改一下这个错误。

examples.en: She wrapped the box with a rubber band.
examples.cn: 她用橡皮筋把盒子捆好。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拉播」——橡皮筋一拉一弹像在拉播弹弓；rubber 读音近似「拉播」

root: 由动词 rub（摩擦）加施动后缀 -er 构成，十八世纪起指能擦去铅笔字的南美弹性材料，动作名转指材料与工具，属英语自生的派生词。

sensesIntro.en: Rubber moves from the elastic material itself to the erasing block, to anything made of rubber, and to rubber footwear.
sensesIntro.cn: rubber 从弹性材料出发，到擦字的橡皮，再到橡胶制品与橡胶套鞋。

core.cn: 核心意象：一块能回弹、能擦字的软材料

branches.cn: 材料因人们最初的摩擦用法而得名。

branches.en: The same word covers the substance and the block that erases with it.
branches.cn: 同一个词既指材料本身，也指用它擦字的工具。

branches.en: Anything made of the material takes its name as an adjective.
branches.cn: 凡由这种材料制成之物，都借材料名作定语。

branches.en: Boots and overshoes are named directly from the material they are made of.

latinIntro.en: Rubber is an English-derived word without Latin relatives.
latinIntro.cn: rubber 属英语自生派生词，没有拉丁同族词。

items.meaning: a thin elastic loop for holding things
items.meaningCN: 橡皮筋；捆东西的弹性小圈
items.example: The letters were tied with a rubber band.
items.exampleCN: 信件用橡皮筋捆着。

items.example: He wears rubber boots to work in the garden.
items.exampleCN: 他穿橡胶雨靴在园子里干活。

items.example: Wear rubber gloves when washing dishes.
items.exampleCN: 洗碗时戴上橡胶手套。

items.meaning: a stamp for printing; approval given without thought
items.meaningCN: 橡皮图章；不经思考的例行批准
items.example: The committee is just a rubber stamp.
items.exampleCN: 这个委员会不过是橡皮图章。

items.example: Natural rubber comes from tropical trees.
items.exampleCN: 天然橡胶取自热带树木。

items.meaning: like rubber in feel or taste
items.meaningCN: 橡胶般的；咬起来韧而弹的
items.example: The meat was tough and rubbery.
items.exampleCN: 这肉又老又韧。

items.example: The squid had a rubbery texture.
items.exampleCN: 这鱿鱼口感像橡胶。

items.meaningCN: 伸长脖子看热闹；好奇张望
items.example: Drivers rubbernecked at the accident.
items.exampleCN: 司机们伸长脖子看事故现场。

items.meaning: rubber overshoes worn over normal shoes
items.meaningCN: 一双橡胶套鞋（美式英语）
items.example: Take your rubbers; it will snow.
items.exampleCN: 带上套鞋，要下雪了。

items.meaning: a tree whose sap yields rubber
items.example: A rubber plant stood in the corner of the office.
items.exampleCN: 办公室角落摆着一株橡皮树。
