贬低；把……说得一无是处（英，非正式）

collocations.zh: 完全不擅长某事（英，非正式）

derivatives.zh: 由 rubbish 加 -y 后缀构成，义为「劣质的；无价值的」
由 rubbish 加 bin 构成的合成词，义为「垃圾桶」

senses.title: Things thrown away
senses.definition: things that are no longer wanted or useful and are thrown away
senses.definitionCN: 不再需要或不再有用而被丢弃的东西
senses.example: The park was full of rubbish after the festival.
senses.exampleCN: 节日过后公园里满是垃圾。
senses.why: What is worn out and swept aside is named for being worthless.
senses.whyCN: 磨损坏了、被扫到一边的东西，因「无用」而得名。

senses.title: Nonsense in speech
senses.definition: talk or ideas that are silly or not true, used to show disagreement
senses.definitionCN: 愚蠢或不真实的话语，常用于表示强烈不同意
senses.example: You are talking rubbish; the train leaves at six, not seven.
senses.exampleCN: 你在胡说，火车六点发车，不是七点。
senses.why: Words as useless as waste take the same name as things as useless as waste.
senses.whyCN: 话语同废物一样毫无价值，便与废物共用一个名字。

senses.title: Something of very poor quality
senses.titleCN: 劣质的东西；毫无价值之物
senses.definition: something of very low quality or no value at all
senses.definitionCN: 质量极差或毫无价值的东西
senses.example: The film was absolute rubbish; we left halfway.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影烂透了，我们中途就离场了。
senses.why: From physical waste the word spreads to any failed product or work.
senses.whyCN: 从有形的垃圾扩展到一切失败的产品或作品。

senses.title: To criticize harshly
senses.definition: to criticize something or someone severely and unfairly, used in British English
senses.definitionCN: 英式英语中指严厉且不公地批评某人某事
senses.example: The critics rubbished his first novel.
senses.exampleCN: 评论家们把他的第一部小说贬得一文不值。
senses.why: Calling a work rubbish as a verb makes the insult into an action.
senses.whyCN: 把「说它是垃圾」变成动词，贬损便由评语化为动作。

intro.en: Rubbish comes from the rub word family with the suffix -ish; it first meant bits worn off by rubbing.
intro.cn: rubbish 属 rub 词族，由后缀 -ish 构成，最初指摩擦磨下的碎屑。

items.en: Rubbish first meant rubbish from building work: stones and bits worn away.
items.cn: rubbish 最初指建筑工程中摩擦磨蚀产生的碎石与碎屑。

items.en: The sense widened from building waste to any worthless material.
items.cn: 十五世纪词义由建筑废料扩大到一切无价值的物质。

items.en: The word began to mean worthless talk and writing.
items.cn: 十六世纪起该词开始指无价值的话语与文字。

items.en: The verb sense of harshly criticizing developed in informal British English.
items.cn: 二十世纪英式非正式英语中发展出「贬低」的动词用法。

items.en: American English prefers garbage and trash, keeping rubbish mainly British.
items.cn: 美式英语更常用 garbage 和 trash，rubbish 主要保留在英式用法中。

note.en: Rubbish has look-alike family words and near-meaning words about waste and nonsense.
note.cn: rubbish 的形近词多属同族，近义词集中在废物与废话的义场。

entries.definition: an eraser; the elastic material
entries.definitionCN: 橡皮；橡胶，与 rubbish 同出 rub 词族，仅后缀不同，需靠语境区分

entries.definition: of very poor quality
entries.definitionCN: 劣质的；无价值的，rubbish 的形容词形式

entries.definition: a container for household waste
entries.definitionCN: 垃圾桶，rubbish 的常见合成词，英式说法

entries.definition: waste material, especially from a kitchen
entries.definitionCN: 垃圾；废物，美式英语的常用词，兼指胡说

entries.definition: things thrown away; worthless people or things
entries.definitionCN: 垃圾；废物，美式英语常用，语气更粗直

entries.definition: talk or ideas that have no meaning or are untrue
entries.definitionCN: 胡话；无意义的言语，只指话语不指实物垃圾

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember rubbish through waste and worthless talk.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕废物与废话的记忆路径。

normal.en: RUB + BISH: what rubbing wears off becomes rubbish.
normal.cn: 摩擦（rub）磨下来的碎屑，就是最早的 rubbish。

normal.en: Take out the rubbish every evening: bin it, don't keep it.
normal.cn: 每天晚上把垃圾拿出去：进桶，不留。

normal.en: Talk RUBBISH means your words belong in the bin.
normal.cn: talk rubbish 意思是你说的话该进垃圾桶。

normal.en: British people say rubbish; Americans say garbage or trash.
normal.cn: 英国人说 rubbish，美国人说 garbage 或 trash，同一堆垃圾不同叫法。

normal.en: The film was rubbish: it deserved the bin from the first scene.
normal.cn: 这部电影是垃圾：从第一个镜头起就该扔进桶里。

abstract.en: Picture a full bin bag swinging at the gate, waiting to go.
abstract.cn: 想象一只鼓胀的垃圾袋挂在门边，等着被收走。

abstract.en: Hear empty words scatter like paper blown down the street.
abstract.cn: 听空洞的话语像废纸一样被风吹散在街上。

abstract.en: See a bad movie poster crumpled and tossed into a bin.
abstract.cn: 看一张烂片海报被揉成一团扔进垃圾桶。

examples.en: Please put the rubbish in the bin, not on the ground.
examples.cn: 请把垃圾扔进桶里，不要扔在地上。

examples.en: That explanation is complete rubbish.
examples.cn: 那个解释完全是胡说八道。

examples.en: The critics rubbished the play from opening night.
examples.cn: 从首演之夜起评论家们就把这出戏贬得一无是处。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「垃圾师」——读音近似「垃圾是」，扫地的师傅清走垃圾；rubbish 读音近似「拉比师」

root: 属 rub（摩擦）词族，由后缀 -ish 构成，最初指摩擦磨蚀产生的碎屑废料，后经「无用之物」引申出废话与贬低义，一般认为是英语内部派生。

sensesIntro.en: Rubbish moves from waste material to worthless talk, to anything of poor quality, and to the act of harsh criticism.
sensesIntro.cn: rubbish 从垃圾废物出发，到废话胡说，再到一切劣质之物，最后成为贬损的动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: worthless things swept aside and thrown away
core.cn: 核心意象：被扫到一边、扔掉的无用之物

branches.en: Material waste is the base image of the word.
branches.cn: 物质的垃圾是这个词的基础画面。

branches.en: Words as useless as waste take the waste name.
branches.cn: 话语同废物一样无用，便共用废物之名。

branches.en: From lying words to bad films, worthlessness spreads through everything.
branches.cn: 从谎话到烂片，「毫无价值」覆盖一切领域。

branches.en: Saying something is rubbish becomes the verb of rubbishing it.
branches.cn: 「说它是垃圾」凝固成贬低的动词。

branches.en: Both the bin and the critic send things to the same fate.
branches.cn: 垃圾桶与毒舌评论让东西走向同一个下场。

intro.en: Rubbish builds compounds around bins, dumps, and worthless talk.
intro.cn: rubbish 的构词围绕垃圾桶、垃圾场与废话展开。

latinIntro.en: Rubbish is an English-derived word without Latin relatives.
latinIntro.cn: rubbish 属英语内部派生词，没有拉丁同族词。

items.example: Put the peelings in the rubbish bin.
items.exampleCN: 把果皮扔进垃圾桶。

items.meaning: a place where waste is taken and left
items.example: The old quarry is now a rubbish dump.
items.exampleCN: 旧采石场如今成了垃圾场。

items.example: Household rubbish is collected on Mondays.
items.exampleCN: 生活垃圾每周一收运。

items.meaning: to say silly or untrue things
items.example: He talks rubbish when he is nervous.
items.exampleCN: 他一紧张就胡说八道。

items.meaningCN: 彻头彻尾的垃圾；毫无价值的东西
items.example: The report is absolute rubbish.
items.exampleCN: 这份报告纯属垃圾。

items.example: He sold rubbishy souvenirs to tourists.
items.exampleCN: 他向游客兜售劣质纪念品。

items.meaningCN: 完全不擅长（英式非正式）
items.example: I am rubbish at singing.
items.exampleCN: 我唱歌一塌糊涂。

items.meaning: the regular taking away of waste
items.example: Rubbish collection is twice a week here.
items.exampleCN: 这里每周清运两次垃圾。

items.meaningCN: 把人当垃圾看待；作践（非正式说法）
items.example: Stop treating her like rubbish.
items.exampleCN: 别再把她当 garbage 一样作践。

items.meaningCN: 被贬低的；被说得一无是处的
items.example: His early work was rubbished by critics.
items.exampleCN: 他早期作品被评论家们贬得一文不值。

definition_zh: 无礼的；粗鲁的；粗俗的；粗糙简陋的
definition_en: not polite, offensive in manner or speech, or simple and roughly made
core_image: 一句话脱口而出、撞痛了别人
scene: 他打断别人的话，还翻了个白眼，大家都很尴尬。It was rude of him to interrupt the speaker again and again.
sceneCN: 这里 rude 是「无礼的」（第 1 个义项：不礼貌、冒犯他人）；句意：他一次次打断演讲者，真是无礼。

pos.zh: 无礼的；粗鲁的；粗俗的；简陋的

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加 -ly 后缀构成，义为「无礼地；粗鲁地」
由形容词加 -ness 后缀构成，义为「无礼；粗鲁」
与 rude 同源（经 crude），义为「粗糙；生硬」

senses.title: Not polite
senses.definition: not polite; likely to offend or upset someone by what you say or do
senses.definitionCN: 不礼貌，言语举止易冒犯或触怒他人
senses.example: It is rude to stare at strangers.
senses.exampleCN: 盯着陌生人看是不礼貌的。
senses.why: Behaviour that hits others without care offends the rules of politeness.
senses.whyCN: 不顾及他人感受的言行，直接冒犯了礼貌的规矩。

senses.title: Coarse and offensive
senses.definition: referring to sex or bodily functions in an offensive or embarrassing way
senses.definitionCN: 以冒犯或令人难堪的方式谈及性或身体机能
senses.example: The comedian told rude jokes all night.
senses.exampleCN: 那位喜剧演员整晚都在讲下流笑话。
senses.why: What offends politeness in general offends decency in particular.
senses.whyCN: 泛义的冒犯礼貌，落在特定话题上便成了粗俗。

senses.title: Simple and roughly made
senses.definition: simple and basic, made or done without skill or refinement
senses.definitionCN: 制作或做法简单原始，缺乏技巧与精细
senses.example: They lived in a rude hut on the hillside.
senses.exampleCN: 他们住在山坡上一间简陋的小屋里。
senses.why: Without polish or care, a thing stays rough, just as manners without care stay rude.
senses.whyCN: 缺乏打磨的东西停留在粗粝状态，正如缺乏修养的举止停留在粗鲁。

senses.title: Vigorous and strong
senses.titleCN: 健壮的；蓬勃的（in rude health）
senses.definition: strong and healthy, used in the phrase in rude health
senses.definitionCN: 在短语 in rude health 中指身体强壮、精力旺盛
senses.example: At eighty, my grandfather is still in rude health.
senses.exampleCN: 我祖父八十岁了，身体依然硬朗。
senses.why: Rough, unpolished strength needs no decoration, so rude came to praise raw vigor.
senses.whyCN: 未经修饰的力量自有一种生命力，rude 由此反转为对强健的赞语。

intro.en: Rude comes from Latin rudis, meaning untrained, unlearned, or raw.
intro.cn: rude 来自拉丁语 rudis，意为未经训练的、无学识的、原始的。

items.en: Rudis described raw material and untrained people, anything lacking polish or education.
items.cn: 拉丁语 rudis 形容未经打磨的材料与未受训的人，泛指一切缺乏修饰之物。

items.en: Old French took the word as rude, keeping the sense of rough and unlearned.
items.cn: 古法语承袭为 rude，保留粗野与无学识之义。

items.en: Rude entered English meaning uneducated and unskilled before it meant impolite.
items.cn: rude 进入英语时先指无学识、无技艺，之后才有「无礼」义。

items.en: The politeness sense grew as court manners became a measure of worth.
items.cn: 随着宫廷礼仪成为衡量人的标尺，「无礼」义逐渐占上风。

items.en: Rude now mostly means impolite, with older senses surviving in fixed phrases.
items.cn: 今天 rude 以「无礼」为主义，旧义保留在 in rude health 等固定短语中。

note.en: Rude has look-alike words from the same Latin root and near-meaning words about impoliteness.
note.cn: rude 的形近词多出自同一拉丁词根，近义词集中在失礼与粗俗的义场。

entries.definition: natural and unprocessed; offensive in a blunt way
entries.definitionCN: 天然的；粗鲁直白的，与 rude 同出拉丁语 rudis，读音相近、侧重未加工

entries.definition: a person who is easily shocked by matters of sex
entries.definitionCN: 过分拘谨的人，拼写与 rude 仅差首字母，词源不同，只是形近

entries.definition: a cross or crucifix, an old word
entries.definitionCN: 十字架（古语），读音与 rude 完全相同，词源无关，需靠语境区分

entries.definition: not polite; lacking good manners
entries.definitionCN: 不礼貌的，语气较 rude 更中性、更正式

entries.definition: not polite; showing no courtesy
entries.definitionCN: 失礼的；不恭敬的，正式用语，强调缺乏礼数

entries.definition: rude in a bold and disrespectful way to a superior
entries.definitionCN: 傲慢无礼的，特指对尊长放肆，比 rude 更具挑衅性

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember rude through Latin rudis and rough manners.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕拉丁词根 rudis 与粗鲁举止的记忆路径。

normal.en: RUDE comes from Latin rudis: unpolished people give unpolished answers.
normal.cn: RUDE 源自拉丁语 rudis（未打磨），未经打磨的人说话自然不中听。

normal.en: CRUDE and RUDE are cousins: both mean raw and unrefined.
normal.cn: CRUDE 与 RUDE 是同根兄弟，都指原始、未经修饰。

normal.en: A rude reply has no please, no thank you, no softness.
normal.cn: 无礼的答复里没有 please，没有谢谢，毫无 softness。

normal.en: In RUDE health means so strong it is almost unpolished force.
normal.cn: in rude health 指硬朗得近乎原始的生命力。

normal.en: Rude Awakening: a rude shock wakes you like a splash of cold water.
normal.cn: rude awakening 是一盆冷水般的当头棒喝，把人惊醒。

abstract.en: See a stone wall built without mortar: strong but rough, like rude manners.
abstract.cn: 看一堵不用灰浆垒起的石墙：结实而粗粝，正如粗鲁的举止。

abstract.en: Hear a door slammed instead of closed quietly.
abstract.cn: 听「砰」的一声摔门，而不是轻轻带上的门。

abstract.en: Picture a farmer rising at dawn, rough-handed and full of life.
abstract.cn: 想象黎明即起的农夫，双手粗粝却生机勃勃。

examples.en: It is rude to talk with your mouth full.
examples.cn: 嘴里塞满食物说话是不礼貌的。

examples.en: She apologized for her rude remark at dinner.
examples.cn: 她为晚宴上的失言之语道了歉。

examples.en: The old fisherman remained in rude health well into his nineties.
examples.cn: 老渔夫九十多岁身体依然十分硬朗。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「鲁的」——鲁莽的人说话总是「鲁的」，出口伤人；rude 读音近似「鲁的」

root: 源自拉丁语 rudis（未打磨的、未经训练的），经古法语 rude 进入英语；先指无学识、粗糙，后因礼仪之别聚焦为「无礼」，与 crude 同根。

sensesIntro.en: Rude moves from unpolished manners, to coarse speech, to unrefined workmanship, and back to raw strength.
sensesIntro.cn: rude 从未经修饰的举止出发，到粗俗言语、简陋做工，最终回指原始强健的生命力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thing without polish, in stone or in speech
core.cn: 核心意象：未经打磨之物——无论是石头还是言语

branches.en: Manners without care offend everyone nearby.
branches.cn: 不顾及他人的举止冒犯身边所有人。

branches.en: What breaks politeness on ordinary topics breaks decency on private ones.
branches.cn: 在日常话题上失礼，落到私密话题上便是粗俗。

branches.en: Hands without training leave work rough and simple.
branches.cn: 未经训练的手让作品粗糙简陋。

branches.en: The same roughness is a flaw in a hut and a virtue in health.
branches.cn: 同一种粗粝，在小屋是缺陷，在身体上是生命力。

branches.en: An unpolished reply wounds, while unpolished strength endures.
branches.cn: 未经修饰的言语伤人，未经修饰的体魄耐久。

intro.en: Rude builds its family from the Latin sense of unpolished.
intro.cn: rude 的词族围绕拉丁语「未经打磨」之义展开。

latinIntro.en: Rude comes from Latin rudis, so it shares root words with crude.
latinIntro.cn: rude 来自拉丁语 rudis，与 crude 共享同根词。

items.meaning: in an impolite or offensive way
items.example: He pushed past rudely without apologizing.
items.exampleCN: 他粗鲁地挤过去，连道歉都没有。

items.meaningCN: 无礼；粗鲁的行为或态度
items.example: His rudeness cost him the job.
items.exampleCN: 他的无礼让他丢了工作。

items.meaningCN: 天然的；粗俗直白的（同根词）
items.example: Crude oil is pumped straight from the ground.
items.exampleCN: 原油直接从地下抽出。

items.meaning: the state of being raw or offensive
items.example: The film's crudity shocked some viewers.
items.exampleCN: 影片的粗俗让部分观众不适。

items.structure: e- (out of) + rudis, learned out of rawness
items.meaningCN: 博学的（字面义「脱离蒙昧」）
items.example: The erudite professor knew six languages.
items.exampleCN: 这位博学的教授通晓六种语言。

items.meaning: an unpleasant discovery that ends false hopes
items.meaningCN: 当头棒喝；幻想的猛然破灭
items.example: Losing the first match was a rude awakening.
items.exampleCN: 首战失利是一记当头棒喝。

items.example: She came back from the trip in rude health.
items.exampleCN: 旅行归来后她身体非常硬朗。

items.meaningCN: 粗工；手脚笨拙的工匠（莎士比亚用语）
items.example: Shakespeare called the workers rude mechanicals.
items.exampleCN: 莎士比亚称那些工匠为 rude mechanicals。

items.meaning: the first simple steps of a subject
items.example: She learned the rudiments of cooking from her mother.
items.exampleCN: 她跟母亲学了烹饪入门。

items.example: They sheltered in a rude hut overnight.
items.exampleCN: 他们在简陋的小屋里过了一夜。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 未经训练的；无学识的；原始的（rude 的直接来源）

definition_zh: 毁灭；毁坏；使破产；废墟；毁灭的原因
definition_en: to destroy or severely damage something, or the remains of a destroyed building
core_image: 一座塌了顶的老楼，断墙残垣立在原地
scene: 大火过后，整座房子只剩下焦黑的骨架。The fire ruined the old wooden house completely.
sceneCN: 这里 ruin 是「毁坏」（第 1 个义项：彻底摧毁或严重损坏）；句意：大火把那座老木屋彻底毁掉了。

pos.zh: 毁坏；毁灭；使破产；糟蹋
毁灭；废墟；破产；祸根

derivatives.zh: 由名词加 -ous 后缀构成，义为「毁灭性的；导致破产的」
由形容词加 -ly 后缀构成，义为「毁灭性地；（价格）极高昂地」

senses.title: To destroy or damage badly
senses.definition: to spoil or destroy something completely or severely
senses.definitionCN: 彻底糟蹋或严重毁坏某物
senses.example: The flood ruined the harvest that year.
senses.exampleCN: 那年的洪水毁了收成。
senses.why: A thing struck hard enough loses its shape and value at once.
senses.whyCN: 打击足够重，东西的形状与价值瞬间尽失。

senses.title: To make someone lose all their money
senses.definition: to cause someone to lose all their money or business
senses.definitionCN: 使人失去全部钱财或生意
senses.example: One bad investment ruined him financially.
senses.exampleCN: 一笔失败的投资让他倾家荡产。
senses.why: A person's fortune is a structure too, and it can collapse like a building.
senses.whyCN: 人的财富也是一座建筑，同样会像房屋一样坍塌。

senses.title: The remains of a destroyed building
senses.definition: the parts of a building that remain after it has been destroyed, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 建筑被毁后剩下的部分，常用复数
senses.example: Tourists walk among the ruins of the ancient temple.
senses.exampleCN: 游客们在古庙的废墟间穿行。
senses.why: What destruction leaves behind keeps the name of the destruction itself.
senses.whyCN: 毁灭留下的残骸，沿用了毁灭这个词本身的名字。

senses.title: The cause of destruction
senses.definition: the thing that causes someone's downfall or loss
senses.definitionCN: 导致某人垮台或损失的东西
senses.example: Gambling was the ruin of the whole family.
senses.exampleCN: 赌博是整个家庭败落的祸根。
senses.why: The act of ruining is pinned onto the thing that did the ruining.
senses.whyCN: 「毁掉」这个动作被固定到实施毁灭的东西身上。

intro.en: Ruin comes from Latin ruina, a falling down or collapse, from ruere, to fall.
intro.cn: ruin 来自拉丁语 ruina（倒塌、崩落），动词词根 ruere 意为坠落。

items.en: Ruere means to rush or fall down, and ruina names the collapse itself.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ruere 意为冲落、坠下，ruina 由此指崩塌本身。

items.en: Old French carried the word as ruine, meaning collapse and destruction.
items.cn: 古法语将该词承袭为 ruine，指崩塌与毁灭。

items.en: Ruin entered English in the fourteenth century for the fall of buildings and of persons.
items.cn: 十四世纪 ruin 进入英语，兼指建筑与人身的倾覆。

items.en: Financial ruin became a standard use as commerce grew.
items.cn: 十六世纪起随商业发展，倾家荡产成为标准用法。

items.en: Ruins is now the usual word for ancient remains that tourists visit.
items.cn: 如今 ruins 是指称古迹残骸、供游客参观的常用说法。

note.en: Ruin has near-meaning words about destruction and look-alike words of different origin.
note.cn: ruin 的近义词集中在毁坏义场，形近词多属异源。

entries.definition: causing great damage or enormous expense
entries.definitionCN: 毁灭性的；（代价）高得倾家荡产的，ruin 的形容词形式

entries.definition: a small red-breasted bird
entries.definitionCN: 知更鸟，与 ruin 拼写部分相同，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: costing so much that it destroys one's finances
entries.definitionCN: 贵得让人破产的，ruin 的副词搭配，强调代价之高

entries.definition: to put an end to something by breaking it completely
entries.definitionCN: 摧毁；消灭，强调动作的结果，不特指坍塌意象

entries.definition: to break a ship, building, or plan completely
entries.definitionCN: 使失事；破坏，多用于船、车与计划

entries.definition: to fall down suddenly; to fail suddenly
entries.definitionCN: 倒塌；崩溃，与 ruin 同属坠落意象，强调过程而非结果

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember ruin through falling and collapse.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕坠落与崩塌的记忆路径。

normal.en: RUIN sounds like RUIN DOWN: the roof falling in.
normal.cn: RUIN 读起来就像屋顶「轰然」砸下的声音，崩塌感十足。

normal.en: Latin RUERE means to fall: a ruin is what has fallen.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 ruere 意为坠落：废墟就是倒下之后剩下的东西。

normal.en: Ancient ruins are walls left standing after the fall.
normal.cn: 古迹废墟是大楼倒塌后仍然站着的几面残墙。

normal.en: Debts pile up like stones until your finances collapse into ruin.
normal.cn: 债务像石块一样越堆越高，直到财务轰然倒塌。

normal.en: One wet phone in your pocket can ruin the whole day.
normal.cn: 口袋里进水的一部手机，就能毁掉一整天。

abstract.en: Watch a tower of blocks tip slowly and crash down.
abstract.cn: 看积木塔缓缓倾斜，然后哗啦倒塌。

abstract.en: See a garden drowned by one night of endless rain.
abstract.cn: 看一夜连绵大雨把整座花园泡烂。

abstract.en: Picture a broken bank building standing empty, its doorway open to the sky.
abstract.cn: 想象一座倒闭的银行空立街角，门洞朝天。

examples.en: The storm ruined our plans for a picnic.
examples.cn: 暴风雨毁了我们野餐的计划。

examples.en: They visited the ruins of the old city wall.
examples.cn: 他们参观了旧城墙的遗迹。

examples.en: His lawsuit nearly ruined the family business.
examples.cn: 那场官司几乎毁掉了家族企业。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「入阴」——大楼倒塌入于阴沟废墟之中；ruin 读音近似「入阴」

root: 源自拉丁语 ruere（坠落）的名词 ruina（崩塌），经古法语 ruine 于十四世纪进入英语；毁灭、破产、废墟诸义皆由「倒塌」意象生出。

sensesIntro.en: Ruin moves from falling down, to total destruction, to lost fortunes, to the remains and the cause.
sensesIntro.cn: ruin 从「坠落」出发，到彻底毁坏、倾家荡产，再到废墟残骸与祸根。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: something heavy falling down and breaking
core.cn: 核心意象：重物坠落、轰然坍塌

branches.en: A hard blow flattens what stood before.
branches.cn: 沉重一击把原本立着的东西夷平。

branches.en: A fortune is a building too, and it collapses the same way.
branches.cn: 财富也是一座建筑，同样会以同样的方式坍塌。

branches.en: What the fall leaves behind is called by the fall's own name.
branches.cn: 倒塌留下的残骸，以「倒塌」本身命名。

branches.en: The destroyer becomes the name of the destruction.
branches.cn: 实施毁灭者被固定为毁灭的代称。

branches.en: Ruins visited by tourists and gambler's ruin share one fall.
branches.cn: 游客凭吊的废墟与赌徒的破产，共享同一场坠落。

intro.en: Ruin builds its family around collapse and heavy loss.
intro.cn: ruin 的词族围绕崩塌与重大损失展开。

latinIntro.en: Ruin comes from Latin ruina, so it has Latin-rooted relatives.
latinIntro.cn: ruin 来自拉丁语 ruina，故有拉丁同根词。

items.meaningCN: 毁灭性的；代价极其高昂的
items.example: The war had a ruinous effect on trade.
items.exampleCN: 战争对贸易造成毁灭性影响。

items.meaning: in a way that destroys or costs too much
items.meaningCN: 毁灭性地；（价格）高得离谱地
items.example: The repairs were ruinously expensive.
items.exampleCN: 修缮费用高得让人破产。

items.example: The ruins attract visitors every summer.
items.exampleCN: 废墟每年夏天吸引众多游客。

items.meaning: to decay gradually into a broken state
items.example: The manor fell into ruin after the war.
items.exampleCN: 庄园战后日渐荒废。

items.meaning: to be the cause of someone's downfall
items.example: Drink was the ruin of him.
items.exampleCN: 酗酒毁了他一生。

items.meaning: to spoil someone's plans or mood completely
items.meaningCN: 把某人的一天彻底毁掉
items.example: The flat tire ruined my day.
items.exampleCN: 爆胎毁了我一天的心情。

items.example: The fire caused irreparable ruin to the library.
items.exampleCN: 大火给图书馆造成无法挽回的损失。

items.example: We toured the ancient ruins at sunrise.
items.exampleCN: 日出时我们游览了古迹。

items.meaningCN: 被毁的；破产的；精疲力竭的
items.example: He returned home ruined by debt.
items.exampleCN: 他因债务缠身而破产还乡。

items.example: The town lay in ruins after the bombing.
items.exampleCN: 轰炸过后小镇沦为一片废墟。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 崩塌；倒塌（ruin 的直接来源）

definition_zh: 规则；章程；统治；裁定；用尺画线
definition_en: an official instruction about what is allowed, the control of a country, or to decide officially
core_image: 一条笔直的尺：既是画线的工具，也是行为的边界
scene: 考试前老师把考场规则又讲了一遍。Every student must follow the rules during the exam.
sceneCN: 这里 rule 是「规则」（第 1 个义项：规定允许与禁止的条文）；句意：考试期间每个学生都必须遵守规则。

pos.zh: 规则；条例；统治；尺子；惯例
统治；管理；裁定；用尺画线

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 后缀构成，指「统治者」或「尺子」
由动词加 -ing 转名词，义为「裁决；裁定」
由 over 加 rule 构成，义为「否决；驳回」

senses.title: An official instruction
senses.definition: an official statement of what people must or must not do
senses.definitionCN: 规定人们必须或不许做什么的正式条文
senses.example: The school rules forbid running in the hall.
senses.exampleCN: 校规禁止在走廊里奔跑。
senses.why: A line drawn straight marks the boundary between allowed and forbidden.
senses.whyCN: 一条画直的线标出可与不可的边界，规则便是行为的边界线。

senses.title: To control a country or people
senses.definition: to govern a country and control its people
senses.definitionCN: 治理国家、支配人民
senses.example: The queen ruled the country for forty years.
senses.exampleCN: 女王统治了这个国家四十年。
senses.why: The ruler keeps everyone within the lines, like a ruler keeping a pencil straight.
senses.whyCN: 统治者让所有人守在本分之内，正如尺子让铅笔走直线。

senses.title: To make an official decision
senses.definition: to make an official legal decision about something
senses.definitionCN: 就某事作出正式的法律决定
senses.example: The judge ruled that the evidence was legal.
senses.exampleCN: 法官裁定该证据合法。
senses.why: The one who draws the line also decides where the line falls.
senses.whyCN: 画线之人也决定线落在哪里，裁定即画线的权力。

senses.title: To draw a straight line
senses.definition: to draw a straight line using a ruler or other straight edge
senses.definitionCN: 用直尺或其他直边画出直线
senses.example: Rule a margin down the side of the page.
senses.exampleCN: 在页边用尺画出一道边线。
senses.why: The tool and the action share one name: what rules also rules lines.
senses.whyCN: 工具与动作共用一名：尺子画线，就是 rule 的本义。

intro.en: Rule comes from Latin regula, a straight bar or measuring stick, from regere, to keep straight or guide.
intro.cn: rule 来自拉丁语 regula（直杆、标尺），动词词根 regere 意为扶正、引导。

items.en: Regere means to keep straight or direct, and regula is the straight bar used for measuring.
items.cn: 拉丁语 regere 意为扶直、引导，regula 是测量用的直杆。

items.en: Old French carried the word as reule, covering both the bar and its use.
items.cn: 古法语承袭为 reule，兼指直杆及其使用。

items.en: Rule entered English in the thirteenth century with all its senses already joined.
items.cn: 十三世纪 rule 进入英语，诸义项此时已经关联。

items.en: Drawing lines with a ruler and governing a people were seen as one act: keeping things straight.
items.cn: 用尺画线与统治人民被视为同一件事：让一切保持笔直。

items.en: Rule out and as a rule extend the line image into daily speech.
items.cn: rule out 与 as a rule 等短语把直线的意象延伸到日常表达之中。

note.en: Rule has look-alike words from the same Latin root and near-meaning words about governing.
note.cn: rule 的形近词多出自同一拉丁词根，近义词集中在治理义场。

entries.definition: a person who governs; a flat strip for drawing lines
entries.definitionCN: 统治者；尺子，rule 加 -er 的同根派生词，两义并存

entries.definition: to control something by means of rules
entries.definitionCN: 管制；调节，与 rule 同出拉丁语 regere，经由 regula 而来

entries.definition: a ridge of rock near the water surface
entries.definitionCN: 暗礁，与 rule 读音部分相近，词源无关，只是音近

entries.definition: an official rule made by a government or organization
entries.definitionCN: 规章；条例，指官方制定的细则，比 rule 更具公文色彩

entries.definition: to control and direct the affairs of a country
entries.definitionCN: 治理；统治，强调管理事务的过程而非条文

entries.definition: the whole system of rules of a country
entries.definitionCN: 法律，指整个国家规则体系，效力高于一般 rule

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember rule through straight lines and governing.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕直线与治理的记忆路径。

normal.en: A RULER draws straight lines: rule keeps people straight too.
normal.cn: 尺子（ruler）画直线，rule 也让人的行为「走直线」。

normal.en: The king RULES: he decides where the boundary falls.
normal.cn: 国王统治（rule）全国，边界线落在哪里由他划定。

normal.en: RULE OUT a suspect: cross one name off the straight list.
normal.cn: 排除（rule out）嫌疑人：从名单上把一个名字划掉。

normal.en: AS A RULE means usually, like trains that run on fixed lines.
normal.cn: as a rule 表示通常，像列车沿固定线路运行。

normal.en: The GOLDEN RULE: treat others as you want to be treated.
normal.cn: 黄金法则（golden rule）：己所欲，施于人。

abstract.en: See a long ruler pressed flat over a row of squirming worms, holding them in one line.
abstract.cn: 想象一把长尺压平了一排蠕动的虫子，把它们捋成一条线。

abstract.en: Hear a judge's gavel fix the boundary once and for all.
abstract.cn: 听法槌落下，边界就此一锤定音。

abstract.en: Watch a pencil glide along the ruler's edge without bending.
abstract.cn: 看铅笔贴着尺缘滑行，笔直不弯。

examples.en: The first rule of the library is to keep quiet.
examples.cn: 图书馆的第一条规则是保持安静。

examples.en: The court ruled in favor of the workers.
examples.cn: 法院裁定工人一方胜诉。

examples.en: She ruled a neat line under the heading.
examples.cn: 她在标题下方用尺画了一条整齐的直线。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「路」——规则定下路，车走直线不越界；rule 读音近似「路欧」

root: 源自拉丁语 regere（扶正、引导）的名词 regula（直杆、标尺），经古法语 reule 进入英语；画线的尺、行为的规则与统治的权杖同出「保持笔直」一义。

sensesIntro.en: Rule moves from the straight bar to written boundaries, to governing, to official decisions, and back to drawing lines.
sensesIntro.cn: rule 从直杆出发，到成文边界、统治权、正式裁定，最后回到用尺画线的本义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight bar that both draws lines and keeps things in line
core.cn: 核心意象：一把既画线又让万物守线的直尺

branches.en: Written rules are straight lines drawn through daily behaviour.
branches.cn: 成文规则是画在日常行为上的一条条直线。

branches.en: The one who holds the bar decides where lines fall for everyone.
branches.cn: 持尺者决定众人之线落在哪里。

branches.en: Governing and judging both keep the country within its lines.
branches.cn: 统治与司法都在让国家守线而行。

branches.en: A judge's ruling and a ruled line share the act of fixing the edge.
branches.cn: 法官的裁定与尺子画出的线，同是「定边」的动作。

branches.en: Rules and rulers share one tool: the straight edge.
branches.cn: 规则与尺子共享同一件工具：直边。

intro.en: Rule builds a large family around the Latin root for keeping straight.
intro.cn: rule 围绕拉丁语「保持笔直」词根构成庞大的词族。

latinIntro.en: Rule comes from Latin regula, so it has many Latin-rooted relatives.
latinIntro.cn: rule 来自拉丁语 regula，故有众多拉丁同根词。

items.meaning: a person who governs; a strip for drawing straight lines
items.example: Use a ruler to draw the graph axis.
items.exampleCN: 画坐标轴请用尺子。

items.meaning: an official decision by a judge or court
items.example: The ruling was read out in court.
items.exampleCN: 裁定在法庭上宣读。

items.example: The agency regulates food safety.
items.exampleCN: 该机构负责食品安全监管。

items.example: New regulations limit noise at night.
items.exampleCN: 新条例限制夜间噪音。

items.meaning: to reject a decision by using higher authority
items.example: The appeal court overruled the earlier decision.
items.exampleCN: 上诉法院驳回了先前的裁定。

items.meaning: to decide that something is impossible
items.example: The doctor ruled out a broken bone.
items.exampleCN: 医生排除了骨折的可能。

items.example: As a rule, I walk to work.
items.exampleCN: 我通常步行上班。

items.meaningCN: 经验法则；粗略的估算方法
items.example: A good rule of thumb is to save ten percent.
items.exampleCN: 一个经验法则是储蓄百分之十。

items.example: Engineers used slide rules before calculators.
items.exampleCN: 计算器出现前工程师用计算尺。

items.meaning: decision by more than half the votes
items.meaningCN: 多数裁定原则；少数服从多数
items.example: The club works by majority rule.
items.exampleCN: 俱乐部实行少数服从多数。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 直杆；标尺（rule 的直接来源）

definition_zh: 跑；奔跑；运行；经营；流淌；竞选
definition_en: to move quickly on foot, to operate or manage something, or to flow
core_image: 双腿快速交替向前的动作：从跑步延展到一切持续运转
scene: 每天清晨他沿着河边跑步锻炼。He runs along the river every morning to keep fit.
sceneCN: 这里 run 是「跑」（第 1 个义项：用双腿快速移动）；句意：他每天早晨沿河跑步锻炼。

pos.zh: 跑；奔跑；运行；经营；流淌；竞选
奔跑；跑步；路程；一连串；运行期

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 后缀构成，指「跑步的人；奔跑的动物」
由 run 加 away 构成，义为「逃跑的；失控的」
由动词加 -ing 转名词，义为「跑步运动；（机器的）运转」

senses.title: To move fast on foot
senses.definition: to move quickly using your legs, faster than walking
senses.definitionCN: 用双腿快速移动，比步行快
senses.example: She runs five kilometres every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天早晨跑五公里。
senses.why: Fast, repeated leg movement is the physical heart of the word.
senses.whyCN: 双腿快速交替，是这个词最根本的身体画面。

senses.title: To operate or manage
senses.definition: to organize or be in charge of a business, event, or machine
senses.definitionCN: 组织或负责企业、活动或机器的运转
senses.example: His sister runs a small bookshop downtown.
senses.exampleCN: 他姐姐在市中心经营一家小书店。
senses.why: A business runs like a machine that keeps moving without stopping.
senses.whyCN: 企业像机器一样持续运转不歇，便沿用了「跑动」这个词。

senses.title: To flow
senses.definition: liquid moves or flows somewhere, or a tap sends water out
senses.definitionCN: 液体流动，或水龙头出水
senses.example: Tears ran down her face during the film.
senses.exampleCN: 看电影时泪水顺着她的脸流下。
senses.why: Flowing water moves fast and continuously, like legs in a run.
senses.whyCN: 流水快速而连续地移动，正如奔跑的双腿。

senses.title: To take part in an election
senses.definition: to try to be elected to a position, used with for
senses.definitionCN: 与 for 连用，指参加竞选谋求职位
senses.example: He will run for mayor next year.
senses.exampleCN: 他明年将竞选市长。
senses.why: An election is a race, and a race is something you run.
senses.whyCN: 竞选就是一场赛跑，赛跑自然要 run。

intro.en: Run comes from Old English rinnan andiernan, meaning to flow or move quickly, of Germanic origin.
intro.cn: run 源自古英语 rinnan/iernan，意为流淌或快速移动，属日耳曼语源。

items.en: The Germanic roots *rinnan and *irnan meant both to flow and to hurry.
items.cn: 日耳曼语词根 *rinnan 与 *irnan 兼指流淌与疾行，一般认为这是 run 的源头。

items.en: Rinnan meant to run or flow, covering water and legs alike.
items.cn: 古英语 rinnan 兼指跑动与流淌，水流与双腿共用一词。

items.en: Run spread to machines, businesses, and noses as English grew practical.
items.cn: 中古英语后期 run 扩展到机器、生意乃至鼻子，词义随生活场景生长。

items.en: Run a machine and run a business became standard industrial-age uses.
items.cn: 工业时代「开动机器」「经营生意」成为标准用法。

items.en: American English fixed run for office as the word for elections.
items.cn: 美式英语确立了 run for office 作为竞选的固定说法，英式则多用 stand。

note.en: Run has look-alike family words and near-meaning words about speed and operation.
note.cn: run 的形近词多属同族，近义词集中在快速移动与运转的义场。

entries.definition: a person or animal that runs fast
entries.definitionCN: 奔跑者；赛跑选手，run 加 -er 的同根派生词

entries.definition: to destroy or the remains of destruction
entries.definitionCN: 毁灭；废墟，与 run 拼写相近，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: past tense of run
entries.definitionCN: run 的过去式，同词的曲折形式，拼写仅一字母之差

entries.definition: to run slowly and steadily for exercise
entries.definitionCN: 慢跑（锻炼），速度低于 run，节奏平稳

entries.definition: to run at top speed for a short distance
entries.definitionCN: 冲刺；短跑，速度高于一般 run，距离短

entries.definition: to take charge of a business or organization
entries.definitionCN: 管理；经营，与 run a business 同义，语气更正式

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember run through legs, water, and work.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕双腿、水流与运转的记忆路径。

normal.en: RUN three letters, three quick steps: r-u-n.
normal.cn: RUN 三个字母像三步快跑：r、u、n 一气呵成。

normal.en: A tap RUNS: water keeps moving like legs.
normal.cn: 水龙头在「跑」（run）：水一直流，就像双腿一直动。

normal.en: She RUNS a cafe: the business keeps going every day.
normal.cn: 她经营一家咖啡馆：生意天天运转不停。

normal.en: RUN for office: elections are races you enter on foot.
normal.cn: 竞选（run for office）：选举就是一场用脚参加的赛跑。

normal.en: In the LONG RUN: the finish line is far away, so think of years.
normal.cn: in the long run：终点线很远，请以年为单位思考。

abstract.en: Feel your breath and heartbeat rising with each stride.
abstract.cn: 感受每一次跨步中呼吸与心跳的升腾。

abstract.en: See a river running steadily between the hills without pause.
abstract.cn: 看河水在群山间奔流不息。

abstract.en: Watch a factory line running day and night.
abstract.cn: 看工厂流水线日夜运转。

examples.en: He ran to catch the last bus home.
examples.cn: 他跑着去赶回家的末班车。

examples.en: The machine runs quietly all day.
examples.cn: 这台机器整天安静地运转。

examples.en: Who will run the project while you are away?
examples.cn: 你不在时谁来负责这个项目？

dict_mnemonic.text: 「跑」的英文 run 读音似「软」——腿一软就跑不动，所以要坚持跑步

root: 源自日耳曼语词根 *rinnan/*irnan（流淌、疾行），古英语 rinnan 直承此义；跑、流、运转、经营诸义皆由「持续快速移动」这一核心画面生出。

sensesIntro.en: Run moves from legs in motion, to machines and businesses in motion, to liquids in motion, and to entering a race for office.
sensesIntro.cn: run 从奔跑的双腿出发，到机器与企业的运转、液体的流动，最后到投身竞选这场赛跑。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: continuous fast movement
core.cn: 核心意象：持续快速的移动

branches.en: Legs moving fast are the base image.
branches.cn: 双腿疾行是这个词的基础画面。

branches.en: A business runs like a body that never stops moving.
branches.cn: 企业像永不停步的身体一样运转。

branches.en: Water moves fast and continuously, just like a runner.
branches.cn: 水流快速而持续，正如奔跑者。

branches.en: An election is a race, so candidates run for office.
branches.cn: 选举是赛跑，候选人便 run for office。

branches.en: Taps and factories both run without legs.
branches.cn: 水龙头与工厂都没有腿，却都在 run。

intro.en: Run builds compounds and phrasal verbs across speed, work, and flow.
intro.cn: run 的构词与短语覆盖速度、工作与流动三大领域。

latinIntro.en: Run is a Germanic word without Latin relatives, so no Latin entries are listed.
latinIntro.cn: run 属日耳曼语源词，没有拉丁同族词，故不列拉丁词条。

items.meaning: a person or animal that runs
items.example: The runners gathered at the start line.
items.exampleCN: 选手们在起跑线集结。

items.example: Buy proper running shoes before training.
items.exampleCN: 训练前先买双合适的跑鞋。

items.meaning: to have no more of something
items.example: We ran out of fuel on the way.
items.exampleCN: 我们在半路耗尽了燃料。

items.meaning: to meet by chance; to begin to have problems
items.example: I ran into an old friend at the station.
items.exampleCN: 我在车站偶遇一位老友。

items.meaning: having escaped control; rising very fast
items.example: The runaway horse was caught by the farmer.
items.exampleCN: 农夫捉住了脱缰的马。

items.meaning: over a long period of time
items.example: In the long run, saving money helps.
items.exampleCN: 从长远来看，存钱是有益的。

items.meaning: to make short trips to do small tasks
items.example: She spent the morning running errands.
items.exampleCN: 她一上午都在跑腿办事。

items.meaning: a long strip where planes take off
items.example: The plane waited on the runway.
items.exampleCN: 飞机在跑道上等候。

items.meaning: the period just before an important event
items.example: In the run-up to the exam she studied nightly.
items.exampleCN: 考试前夕她每晚复习。

items.example: He decided to run for office at forty.
items.exampleCN: 他四十岁那年决定竞选公职。

definition_zh: 乡村的；农村的；田园的
definition_en: connected with the countryside rather than the city
core_image: 城市围墙之外：田垄、牛群与炊烟
scene: 公交车驶出城区，窗外是大片绿油油的田野。They enjoyed the peaceful rural scenery on the way to the village.
sceneCN: 这里 rural 是「乡村的」（第 1 个义项：与农村而非城市相关）；句意：去村庄的路上他们欣赏着宁静的田园风光。

pos.zh: 乡村的；农村的；田园的

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加 -ly 后缀构成，义为「在农村；以乡村方式」
与 rural 同出拉丁语 rus（乡村），义为「乡下的；质朴的」
由 rural 加 -ize 后缀构成，义为「使具有乡村特点；使乡下化」

senses.title: Of the countryside
senses.definition: relating to the countryside or to farming areas far from cities
senses.definitionCN: 与农村或远离城市的耕作地区相关
senses.example: More than half the country's people live in rural areas.
senses.exampleCN: 该国一半以上的人口住在农村地区。
senses.why: The Latin word for open land points away from the walled city.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语的「旷野」一词直指城墙之外的天地。

senses.title: Characteristic of country life
senses.titleCN: 田园气息的；乡野风味的
senses.definition: having the qualities typical of life in the countryside, such as quiet and simplicity
senses.definitionCN: 具有乡村生活的典型气质，如宁静与质朴
senses.example: The inn keeps its rural charm with wooden beams and open fires.
senses.exampleCN: 这家小旅馆保留着木梁与炉火带来的乡村韵味。
senses.why: Whatever the countryside does well becomes an adjective for its character.
senses.whyCN: 乡村所擅长的气质，凝结成描述其风味的形容词。

senses.title: Relating to farming
senses.definition: connected with agriculture and farm work
senses.definitionCN: 与农业及农事劳动相关
senses.example: The government raised rural subsidies this year.
senses.exampleCN: 政府今年提高了农业补贴。
senses.why: Open land exists to be farmed, so rural reaches straight into agriculture.
senses.whyCN: 旷野生来就是为耕作而存在，rural 由此直通农业。

intro.en: Rural comes from Latin ruralis, from rus, the open country, as opposed to the walled town.
intro.cn: rural 来自拉丁语 ruralis，词根 rus 意为旷野乡村，与有围墙的城镇相对。

items.en: Rus means the open country, and ruralis means belonging to that open land.
items.cn: 拉丁语 rus 指旷野乡村，ruralis 意为属于这片旷野的。

items.en: The same root gives rusticus, rough and countrylike, later English rustic.
items.cn: 同一词根派生出 rusticus（乡野的、粗朴的），即英语 rustic 的来源。

items.en: Old French carried rural into the romance languages unchanged in sense.
items.cn: 古法语将 rural 原义传入罗曼语族诸语言。

items.en: Rural entered English in the fifteenth century as a learned Latin borrowing.
items.cn: 十五世纪 rural 作为学术性拉丁借词进入英语。

items.en: Rural now stands opposite urban in statistics, planning, and daily speech.
items.cn: 如今 rural 在统计、规划与日常语言中与 urban 相对成对。

note.en: Rural has look-alike words from the same Latin root and near-meaning words about the countryside.
note.cn: rural 的形近词多出自同一拉丁词根，近义词集中在乡村义场。

entries.definition: simple and typical of the countryside, sometimes rough
entries.definitionCN: 质朴的；粗犷的，与 rural 同出拉丁语 rus，更强调朴素粗朴

entries.definition: in or relating to rural places
entries.definitionCN: 在农村；以乡村方式，rural 的副词形式

entries.definition: to make a low heavy rolling sound
entries.definitionCN: 发出低沉的隆隆声，与 rural 拼写部分相同，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: land away from towns and cities
entries.definitionCN: 乡间；田野，名词指地本身，rural 是形容词指属性

entries.definition: relating to shepherds and idealized country life
entries.definitionCN: 田园牧歌式的；牧人的，带文学美化色彩

entries.definition: relating to land, farming, or its reform
entries.definitionCN: 土地的；农业的，多用于正式的农业政策语境

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember rural through open land and its Latin root.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕旷野与拉丁词根的记忆路径。

normal.en: RURAL contains RUR, from Latin rus: the open country.
normal.cn: RURAL 里的 RUR 来自拉丁语 rus（旷野），词根就是乡村本身。

normal.en: RURAL is the opposite of URBAN: cows versus crowds.
normal.cn: RURAL 与 URBAN 相对：一边是牛群，一边是人潮。

normal.en: Rustic furniture and RURAL life both come from the same Latin field.
normal.cn: rustic（质朴的）与 rural 同一块拉丁语田野里长出来。

normal.en: RURAL schools are small, with one teacher for many grades.
normal.cn: 乡村学校规模小，一位老师教好几个年级。

normal.en: The RURAL bus stops at every farm gate along the lane.
normal.cn: 乡间班车在小路旁每一户农场门口都停。

abstract.en: See wheat bending in wind as far as the eye can reach.
abstract.cn: 看一望无际的麦浪在风中起伏。

abstract.en: Hear a rooster instead of traffic noise at dawn.
abstract.cn: 听清晨的鸡鸣取代了车流声。

abstract.en: Picture a fence, a field, and a farmhouse with smoke rising.
abstract.cn: 想象一道篱笆、一片田，农舍上炊烟袅袅。

examples.en: The hospital serves many small rural communities.
examples.cn: 这家医院服务着许多乡村小社区。

examples.en: Rural incomes have risen slowly in recent years.
examples.cn: 近年来农村收入增长缓慢。

examples.en: She prefers the quiet of rural France to city life.
examples.cn: 比起城市生活，她更喜欢法国乡间的宁静。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「乳肉」——乡下养牛，既出乳又出肉；rural 读音近似「乳肉」

root: 源自拉丁语 rus（旷野乡村）的形容词 ruralis，属学术性借词，十五世纪进入英语；与 rustic 同根，与 urban 相对。

sensesIntro.en: Rural moves from open land beyond the city, to the character of country life, to farming itself.
sensesIntro.cn: rural 从城市之外的旷野出发，到乡村生活的气质，再到农业本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: open farmland outside the city walls
core.cn: 核心意象：城墙之外开阔的农田

branches.en: Open land beyond the town is the base image.
branches.cn: 城郭之外的旷野是这个词的基础画面。

branches.en: The land's quietness becomes the character of life upon it.
branches.cn: 旷野的宁静沉淀为乡村生活的气质。

branches.en: Open land exists to be farmed, so rural covers agriculture.
branches.cn: 旷野为耕作而生，rural 因此覆盖农业。

branches.en: Farm work and country charm are two faces of the same field.
branches.cn: 农事劳作与田园风情是同一片田野的两副面孔。

branches.en: Urban and rural divide every map into two colors.
branches.cn: urban 与 rural 把每张地图分成两种颜色。

intro.en: Rural keeps a small learned family built on Latin rus.
intro.cn: rural 的词族小巧而学术，都建立在拉丁语 rus 之上。

latinIntro.en: Rural comes from Latin ruralis, built on rus, so it has Latin-rooted relatives.
latinIntro.cn: rural 来自拉丁语 ruralis（建立在 rus 之上），故有拉丁同根词。

items.meaning: in a rural way or place
items.example: Rurally located schools need more teachers.
items.exampleCN: 地处乡村的学校需要更多教师。

items.example: They ate at a rustic wooden table.
items.exampleCN: 他们坐在粗朴的木桌旁用餐。

items.example: The park ruralized the edge of the city.
items.exampleCN: 这座公园让城市边缘有了田园气息。

items.example: Rural areas lack fast internet.
items.exampleCN: 农村地区缺少高速网络。

items.meaning: the movement of people from the country to cities
items.example: The rural exodus emptied many villages.
items.exampleCN: 农村人口外流使许多村庄空心化。

items.example: Painters love this rural landscape.
items.exampleCN: 画家们钟爱这片田园风光。

items.example: The clinic serves five rural communities.
items.exampleCN: 诊所服务五个乡村社区。

items.meaningCN: 乡村人口流失（青年进城）
items.example: Rural flight worries the local mayor.
items.exampleCN: 青年外流令当地镇长担忧。

items.example: Non-rural districts pay higher taxes.
items.exampleCN: 非乡村地区税率更高。

items.meaningCN: 土地的；农业的（同场域近亲）
items.example: The country passed an agrarian reform law.
items.exampleCN: 该国通过了土地改革法。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 乡村的（rural 的直接来源）

definition_zh: 冲；急忙；仓促；猛攻；匆忙；灯心草
definition_en: to move suddenly and quickly, to do something too fast, or a sudden movement of people
core_image: 水流冲闸而出：快而不容等待
scene: 下课前铃一响，学生们冲出了教室。The children rushed out of the classroom as soon as the bell rang.
sceneCN: 这里 rush 是「冲；奔」（第 1 个义项：突然快速地移动）；句意：铃声一响孩子们就冲出了教室。

pos.zh: 冲；奔；使急忙；仓促行事
匆忙；忙碌时刻；猛攻；灯心草

collocations.zh: 高峰时段；上下班拥挤时间

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 转形容词，义为「飞奔的；湍急的」
由 rush（灯心草）加 -y 后缀构成，义为「长满灯心草的」

senses.title: To move suddenly and fast
senses.definition: to move somewhere suddenly and very quickly
senses.definitionCN: 突然且非常快速地移向某处
senses.example: Everyone rushed to the window when the parade appeared.
senses.exampleCN: 游行队伍一出现，大家纷纷冲到窗前。
senses.why: Speed plus suddenness is the physical core: no time to walk.
senses.whyCN: 快速加突然是这个词的物理内核：来不及从容。

senses.title: To do something too quickly
senses.definition: to do something too fast without enough care or thought
senses.definitionCN: 做事过快，缺乏足够的细心或思考
senses.example: Do not rush your decision; think it over tonight.
senses.exampleCN: 别急着做决定，今晚好好想想。
senses.why: The same speed that saves time can also spill the water.
senses.whyCN: 省时间的那种快，同样会打翻水盆。

senses.title: A sudden busy period
senses.definition: a period when many people want the same thing at the same time
senses.definitionCN: 许多人在同一时段涌向同处的繁忙时刻
senses.example: Avoid the subway during the morning rush.
senses.exampleCN: 早高峰时段尽量避免坐地铁。
senses.why: Many fast movements at once build a crowd-wave, named by the same word.
senses.whyCN: 众人的疾行叠成一股人潮，便以同一个词相称。

senses.title: A wetland plant
senses.definition: a plant with thin stems that grows in wet ground, unrelated in origin to the verb
senses.definitionCN: 一种茎秆细长、生长于湿地的植物，与动词 rush 词源不同
senses.example: Rushes lined the edge of the quiet pond.
senses.exampleCN: 池塘边长满了一圈灯心草。
senses.why: Two unrelated words share one spelling: one moves fast, one stands still in water.
senses.whyCN: 两个词源无关的词共用一个拼写：一个疾行，一个静立水中。

intro.en: The verb rush probably comes from Old French ruser, to drive back or charge; the plant rush has a different, older source.
intro.cn: 动词 rush 一般认为源自古法语 ruser（击退、冲锋）；植物 rush 则另有一源，更为古老。

items.en: Ruser meant to drive back or charge forward, a soldier's sudden movement.
items.cn: 古法语 ruser 意为击退或冲锋，是士兵的突然动作，一般认为是动词 rush 的源头。

items.en: Rushen appeared in English in the fourteenth century for sudden violent movement.
items.cn: 十四世纪 rushen 进入英语，指突然而猛烈的运动。

items.en: The plant rush comes from Old English resc, a waterside plant, an unrelated word.
items.cn: 植物 rush 来自古英语 resc（水边植物），与动词同形异源。

items.en: The busy-crowd sense grew with cities: rush hour was fixed by the age of commuting.
items.cn: 十七至十九世纪，随城市兴起出现「高峰」义；通勤时代固定下 rush hour 的说法。

items.en: Rush now covers fast people, fast work, fast water, and gold rushes.
items.cn: 今天的 rush 覆盖疾行的人流、赶工、激流以及淘金热。

note.en: Rush has a same-spelling plant word of different origin and near-meaning words about speed.
note.cn: rush 有一个同形异源的植物义词，近义词集中在快速义场。

entries.definition: plural of the fast movement or of the waterside plant
entries.definitionCN: 急速动作的复数或灯心草的复数，同形双义词

entries.definition: a tool with bristles; to touch lightly while passing
entries.definitionCN: 刷子；掠过，与 rush 仅差首字母，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: to press something until it breaks
entries.definitionCN: 压碎；粉碎，与 rush 韵母相同，词源不同，需靠语境区分

entries.definition: to move or act faster than usual
entries.definitionCN: 赶忙；急忙，强调赶时间，未必有猛冲的力度

entries.definition: to run a short distance very quickly
entries.definitionCN: 猛冲；飞奔，距离短、爆发强，常为口语

entries.definition: a sudden mass movement of frightened people or animals
entries.definitionCN: （人群或兽群的）狂奔；蜂拥，规模大且带恐慌色彩

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember rush through sudden speed and water.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕突然疾速与水流的记忆路径。

normal.en: RUSH sounds like the water noise: shhh, the river rushes.
normal.cn: RUSH 听起来像流水声：shhh——河水奔涌而下。

normal.en: RUSH HOUR: everyone moves fast at the same time.
normal.cn: rush hour：所有人同一时刻一起疾行。

normal.en: The Gold RUSH: thousands rushed to find gold.
normal.cn: 淘金热（gold rush）：成千上万人涌去找金子。

normal.en: Do not RUSH a good decision: speed spills the soup.
normal.cn: 好决定别急着做：欲速则打翻了汤。

normal.en: RUSHES stand still by the pond while the water rushes past.
normal.cn: 灯心草静立池边，水却匆匆流过——同形异义的对照。

abstract.en: See a dam gate open and water pour through at once.
abstract.cn: 看水闸开启，水倾泻而出。

abstract.en: Feel the crowd push forward the moment doors open.
abstract.cn: 感受开门瞬间人群涌动的推力。

abstract.en: Hear your alarm and picture shoes flying onto feet.
abstract.cn: 听见闹钟响，眼前浮现飞快套上的鞋。

examples.en: She rushed home when she heard the news.
examples.cn: 听到消息她立刻赶回家。

examples.en: The job must be finished today, but there is no rush on the details.
examples.cn: 工作今天必须完成，不过细节不必赶。

examples.en: We could hear the rush of the river below the bridge.
examples.cn: 我们听得见桥下河水的奔流声。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拉什」——下课时大家「拉什」一下全冲出去；rush 读音近似「拉什」

root: 动词 rush 一般认为源自古法语 ruser（冲锋、击退），十四世纪进入英语；植物 rush 来自古英语 resc，两词同形异源；高峰、奔涌诸义皆由「突然疾速」生出。

sensesIntro.en: Rush moves from sudden fast movement, to hasty work, to crowded peak times, and stands beside the unrelated waterside plant.
sensesIntro.cn: rush 从突然疾行出发，到仓促赶工、高峰人潮，并与词源无关的灯心草同名并立。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: sudden fast movement, like water through an open gate
core.cn: 核心意象：如开闸之水般的突然疾速

branches.en: One body moving suddenly is the base image.
branches.cn: 单个身体的突然疾行是基础画面。

branches.en: Many bodies rushing at once make the rush hour.
branches.cn: 众人同时疾行便形成高峰时刻。

branches.en: The same speed moves your legs too fast for care.
branches.cn: 同一种速度让行动快得顾不上细致。

branches.en: Fast water rushes exactly like a running crowd.
branches.cn: 激流奔涌，与奔涌的人潮如出一辙。

branches.en: The still plant and the moving verb share only a spelling.
branches.cn: 静立的植物与疾行的动词只共享一个拼写。

intro.en: Rush builds compounds around crowds, water, and speed.
intro.cn: rush 的构词围绕人潮、水流与速度展开。

latinIntro.en: Rush is a Germanic-French blend without Latin relatives, so no Latin entries are listed.
latinIntro.cn: rush 属日耳曼-法语混合来源，没有拉丁同族词，故不列拉丁词条。

items.meaning: the busy times when people travel to work
items.meaningCN: 高峰时段；上下班拥挤时间
items.example: The streets are jammed in rush hour.
items.exampleCN: 高峰时段街道拥堵不堪。

items.meaning: an order that must be finished quickly
items.example: The factory took a rush order for masks.
items.exampleCN: 工厂接下一批加急口罩订单。

items.meaning: to produce or leave very quickly
items.example: The paper rushed out a special edition.
items.exampleCN: 报社仓促推出了特刊。

items.meaning: to do something too quickly without thinking
items.example: Do not rush into signing the contract.
items.exampleCN: 别贸然签合同。

items.meaning: a sudden movement of many people to find gold
items.example: The gold rush changed the town forever.
items.exampleCN: 淘金热永远改变了这座小镇。

items.meaning: a sudden strong flow of water
items.example: A rush of water filled the channel.
items.exampleCN: 一股急流灌满了水渠。

items.example: The rushing stream carried leaves away.
items.exampleCN: 湍急的溪流卷走了树叶。

items.meaningCN: 灯心草（复数）；水边细茎植物
items.example: The wind moved through the rushes.
items.exampleCN: 风吹过一片灯心草。

items.meaningCN: 赶工的活儿；仓促完成的任务
items.example: The report was a rush job, full of errors.
items.exampleCN: 那份报告是赶出来的，错漏百出。

items.meaning: to move forward too fast without looking
items.example: He rushed headlong into the burning building.
items.exampleCN: 他奋不顾身冲进燃烧的大楼。

definition_zh: 麻袋；口袋；一袋之量；解雇（英，非正式）；掠夺（古）
definition_en: a large bag made of rough material, the amount a sack holds, or to dismiss someone from a job
core_image: 一只粗布大口袋：装得下粮食，也装得下「卷铺盖走人」的行囊
scene: 农民把刚收获的土豆装进麻袋扛回谷仓。The farmer carried a heavy sack of potatoes into the barn.
sceneCN: 这里 sack 是「麻袋」（第 1 个义项：粗材料做成的大口袋）；句意：农民扛着一袋沉甸甸的土豆走进谷仓。

pos.zh: 麻袋；一袋之量；（英，非正式）解雇
解雇；装袋；（古）洗劫

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 转名词，义为「麻袋布；粗麻布」
由 sack 加 -ful 后缀构成，义为「一袋的量」

senses.title: A large rough bag
senses.definition: a large bag made of strong rough cloth or paper, used for storing and carrying things
senses.definitionCN: 用粗布或厚纸做成的大袋子，用于储存和搬运
senses.example: He tied the top of the sack with a rope.
senses.exampleCN: 他用绳子把麻袋口扎紧。
senses.why: A big open bag that swallows grain whole is the oldest picture of the word.
senses.whyCN: 一口吞下整袋粮食的大开口布袋，是这个词最古老的画面。

senses.title: The amount a sack holds
senses.definition: the amount that a sack contains, used as a measure
senses.definitionCN: 麻袋所容纳的量，用作计量
senses.example: The shop sells flour by the sack.
senses.exampleCN: 这家商店按袋出售面粉。
senses.why: A container lends its name to whatever quantity fills it.
senses.whyCN: 容器之名顺势指称它所盛装的量。

senses.title: To dismiss from a job
senses.definition: to dismiss someone from their job, used in informal British English
senses.definitionCN: 英式非正式用语，指把人从职位上辞退
senses.example: He got the sack for being late again.
senses.exampleCN: 他因再次迟到而被炒了鱿鱼。
senses.why: A dismissed worker packs his belongings into a bag and carries it away.
senses.whyCN: 被辞退的工人把私物装进布袋拎走，「卷铺盖」成了「解雇」的代称。

senses.title: To plunder a town
senses.definition: to loot and destroy a captured town, an older literary use
senses.definitionCN: 旧式书面用法，指攻陷城镇后劫掠破坏
senses.example: Historians describe how the enemy sacked the ancient city.
senses.exampleCN: 史书记载敌军如何洗劫了那座古城。
senses.why: Soldiers emptied a town the way one empties a sack, turning everything out.
senses.whyCN: 士兵清空城镇如同倒空一只麻袋，把一切倾倒出来。

intro.en: Sack comes through Old French from Latin saccus, from Greek sakkos, a bag of coarse cloth.
intro.cn: sack 经古法语来自拉丁语 saccus，词根为希腊语 sakkos（粗布袋）。

items.en: Sakkos in Greek meant a bag or loose cloak of coarse cloth.
items.cn: 希腊语 sakkos 指粗布袋或宽松粗布外套，一般认为是词族源头。

items.en: Latin took the word as saccus, keeping the bag meaning.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入为 saccus，袋义不变。

items.en: Old French carried it as sac into England with the Norman Conquest.
items.cn: 古法语承袭为 sac，随诺曼征服进入英格兰。

items.en: Sack meant the bag, the quantity, and by the seventeenth century the plundering of towns.
items.cn: 中古英语时期 sack 兼指口袋与袋量，十七世纪又添「洗劫城镇」义。

items.en: Get the sack arose from workmen carrying their tools home in a bag when dismissed.
items.cn: 十九世纪英国工人被辞退时把工具装袋带回家，get the sack 由此成为「被解雇」的习语。

note.en: Sack has look-alike family words and near-meaning words about bags and dismissal.
note.cn: sack 的形近词多属同族，近义词集中在袋子与解雇义场。

entries.definition: rough cloth used for making sacks
entries.definitionCN: 麻袋布；粗麻布，sack 的派生词

entries.definition: the amount a sack holds
entries.definitionCN: 一袋的量，sack 加 -ful 的派生词

entries.definition: a small meal eaten between main meals
entries.definitionCN: 零食；点心，与 sack 仅差首字母，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: a container of soft material with handles or an opening
entries.definitionCN: 袋子；提包，泛指一切软质容器，sack 特指粗大麻袋

entries.definition: to dismiss someone from a job
entries.definitionCN: 解雇（英式口语），与 sack 同义，fire 更常用于美式英语

entries.definition: to steal goods from a place by force
entries.definitionCN: 劫掠；抢夺，与 sack 的旧义相近，但强调抢夺而非攻城

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember sack through bags and bad news.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕口袋与坏消息的记忆路径。

normal.en: SACK rhymes with PACK: pack things into a sack.
normal.cn: SACK 与 PACK 押韵：把东西 pack 进 sack 里。

normal.en: A sack race: hop inside a big bag and jump.
normal.cn: 麻袋赛跑：钻进大布袋里蹦跳前进。

normal.en: Hit the sack means hit the bed: sleep time.
normal.cn: hit the sack 意为上床：去和枕头「打交道」。

normal.en: Get the sack: your belongings leave in the same bag.
normal.cn: get the sack：被解雇时，私物还是装进那只布袋带走。

normal.en: One sack of rice feeds a family for weeks.
normal.cn: 一袋大米够一家人吃上好几个星期。

abstract.en: Picture grain pouring into a cloth sack with a soft thud.
abstract.cn: 想象粮食哗啦倒进布袋的沉闷声响。

abstract.en: See a worker carrying a small bag out of the office gate.
abstract.cn: 看一名职员拎着小包走出办公室大门。

abstract.en: Watch an ancient city emptied like a turned-out bag.
abstract.cn: 看一座古城像被倒空的麻袋一样被掠走一切。

examples.en: The warehouse stores hundreds of sacks of coffee beans.
examples.cn: 仓库里储存着数百袋咖啡豆。

examples.en: She bought a sack of onions at the market.
examples.cn: 她在市场上买了一袋洋葱。

examples.en: Two workers were sacked after the accident.
examples.cn: 事故之后有两名工人被解雇了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「塞克」——把东西使劲塞进口袋里；sack 读音近似「塞克」

root: 源自希腊语 sakkos（粗布袋），经拉丁语 saccus、古法语 sac 进入英语；袋、袋量、洗劫诸义一脉相承，「解雇」义则由工人装袋离场的习语而生。

sensesIntro.en: Sack moves from a rough bag, to the amount it holds, to dismissal by the bag one carries out, and to emptied towns.
sensesIntro.cn: sack 从粗布口袋出发，到袋中所盛之量，再到拎袋走人的解雇与被倒空的城池。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one big rough bag that swallows everything
core.cn: 核心意象：一口吞得下一切的大粗布袋

branches.en: The rough cloth bag is the base image.
branches.cn: 粗布大袋是这个词的基础画面。

branches.en: The full bag becomes the unit of trade.
branches.cn: 装满的袋子顺势成为交易计量单位。

branches.en: Carrying your things out in a bag means losing the job.
branches.cn: 把私物装袋带走，意味着丢掉了工作。

branches.en: An emptied town is a sack turned inside out.
branches.cn: 被洗劫的城池就是一只被倒空的麻袋。

branches.en: Hit the sack and get the sack both end with the bag.
branches.cn: hit the sack 与 get the sack 都以那只袋子收场。

intro.en: Sack builds compounds around bags, games, and slang.
intro.cn: sack 的构词围绕口袋、游戏与俚语展开。

latinIntro.en: Sack comes from Greek through Latin, so it has classical-rooted relatives.
latinIntro.cn: sack 经拉丁语来自希腊语，故有古典词根的近亲。

items.example: The floor was covered with sacking.
items.exampleCN: 地上铺着粗麻布。

items.example: He brought a sackful of apples.
items.exampleCN: 他带来一袋苹果。

items.meaning: a packed meal carried in a paper bag
items.example: She took a sack lunch on the hike.
items.exampleCN: 她带着袋装午餐去远足。

items.meaning: a game of hopping inside a sack
items.example: The sack race made everyone laugh.
items.exampleCN: 麻袋赛跑逗得大家哈哈大笑。

items.meaning: to be dismissed from a job
items.example: He got the sack for sleeping at work.
items.exampleCN: 他因上班睡觉被炒了鱿鱼。

items.example: I am tired; time to hit the sack.
items.exampleCN: 我累了，该睡了。

items.example: Heave that sack of potatoes onto the cart.
items.exampleCN: 把那袋土豆扛上推车。

items.example: The old banker gripped his money sack.
items.exampleCN: 老银行家紧攥着钱袋。

items.example: Each camper carried a sleeping sack.
items.exampleCN: 每位露营者都带着简易睡袋。

items.example: The sacked workers held a protest.
items.exampleCN: 被解雇的工人举行了抗议。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 粗布袋（sack 的直接来源）

definition_zh: 悲伤的；令人难过的；糟糕的；暗淡的
definition_en: unhappy or feeling sorrow, or something that makes you feel pity or disappointment
core_image: 嘴角向下垂落的一张脸
scene: 小狗去世后，小女孩整整哭了一个下午。The little girl felt sad after her dog died.
sceneCN: 这里 sad 是「悲伤的」（第 1 个义项：感到忧愁难过）；句意：小狗死后小女孩很难过。

pos.zh: 悲伤的；令人难过的；糟糕的；暗淡的

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加 -ly 后缀构成，义为「悲伤地；令人遗憾的是」
由形容词加 -ness 后缀构成，义为「悲伤；忧愁」
由形容词加 -en 后缀构成，义为「使悲伤；使黯淡」

senses.title: Feeling sorrow
senses.definition: unhappy, with feelings of sorrow or low spirits
senses.definitionCN: 不快乐，心中怀有忧愁或低落的情绪
senses.example: He felt sad when his best friend moved away.
senses.exampleCN: 好友搬走后他感到很难过。
senses.why: A heavy heart pulls the face downward, the visible sign of sorrow.
senses.whyCN: 沉重的心情把嘴角拉向下方，正是悲伤可见的模样。

senses.title: Causing sorrow or pity
senses.titleCN: 令人难过的；令人惋惜的
senses.definition: making people feel sorrow, pity, or regret
senses.definitionCN: 使人产生悲哀、怜悯或遗憾之情
senses.example: It is sad that so many old buildings were torn down.
senses.exampleCN: 那么多老建筑被拆掉，实在令人惋惜。
senses.why: The feeling leaks outward: what makes hearts heavy is called sad too.
senses.whyCN: 情绪向外投射：让人心沉的事也同样被称为 sad。

senses.title: Very bad or unacceptable
senses.definition: very bad or disappointing, used to criticize something's poor state
senses.definitionCN: 非常糟糕或令人失望，用于批评糟糕的现状
senses.example: Their defense in the second half was simply sad.
senses.exampleCN: 他们下半场的防守简直惨不忍睹。
senses.why: Pity for a person extends to pity for anything fallen into a poor state.
senses.whyCN: 对人的怜悯扩展到对一切沦入惨状之物的惋惜。

senses.title: Dull and shabby
senses.definition: dull, dark, or shabby in appearance
senses.definitionCN: 外观上黯淡、灰暗或破旧
senses.example: The room was painted a sad shade of grey.
senses.exampleCN: 房间刷成了黯淡的灰色。
senses.why: Low spirits drain color, so dull and faded things look sad.
senses.whyCN: 低落的情绪抽走了颜色，黯淡褪色的东西便显得 sad。

intro.en: Sad originally meant full or sated, from Old English sæd, and its modern sorrow sense grew out of weariness.
intro.cn: sad 最初意为「饱足的」，源自古英语 sæd，现代「忧愁」义由「倦怠」引申而来。

items.en: The Germanic root *sadas meant full or satisfied.
items.cn: 一般认为日耳曼语词根 *sadas 意为饱足、满足，是 sad 的源头。

items.en: Sæd meant sated, full, or weary of something.
items.cn: 古英语 sæd 意为饱足的，也指对某事感到厌倦。

items.en: Weary and full shifted to firm, serious, and then sorrowful.
items.cn: 中古英语时期词义由倦怠转向坚定、严肃，再转向哀伤。

items.en: The sorrow sense became the main one as the older meanings faded.
items.cn: 十四至十六世纪，随旧义消退，「忧愁」成为主导义项。

items.en: Sad now covers feelings, pity-evoking events, poor quality, and dull colors.
items.cn: 今天 sad 覆盖情绪、令人惋惜之事、低劣状态与黯淡色调。

note.en: Sad has near-meaning words about sorrow and look-alike words of different origin.
note.cn: sad 的近义词集中在哀伤义场，形近词多属异源。

entries.definition: in a sad way; unfortunately
entries.definitionCN: 悲伤地；遗憾的是，sad 的副词形式

entries.definition: past tense of sit
entries.definitionCN: sit 的过去式，与 sad 仅一字母之差，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: to make someone or something sad
entries.definitionCN: 使悲伤；使黯淡，sad 的动词派生词

entries.definition: not happy or satisfied
entries.definitionCN: 不快乐的；不满的，语气比 sad 稍轻，侧重不满

entries.definition: feeling or showing deep sadness
entries.definitionCN: 悲恸的；哀伤的，书面语，程度深于日常 sad

entries.definition: extremely unhappy or uncomfortable
entries.definitionCN: 痛苦的；凄惨的，程度重于 sad，兼指身体不适

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember sad through its old meaning of full.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「饱足」古义的记忆路径。

normal.en: SAD was once FULL: too full of a thing wearies the heart.
normal.cn: sad 曾意为「饱足」：对某事「太满足」也会倦怠生愁。

normal.en: SAD looks like its face: the D droops down at the end.
normal.cn: SAD 的字形像悲伤的脸：结尾的 D 向下垂落。

normal.en: Sad news travels fast: bad things spread quickly.
normal.cn: 坏消息传得快：坏事总是跑得飞快。

normal.en: A sad story ends with tears, not smiles.
normal.cn: 悲伤的故事以眼泪收场，而不是笑容。

normal.en: Sad to say, the old bridge had to go.
normal.cn: sad to say（遗憾的是）：那座老桥终究要拆。

abstract.en: See grey rain falling on an empty playground.
abstract.cn: 看灰色的雨落在空无一人的操场上。

abstract.en: Hear the last note of a slow song fade away.
abstract.cn: 听慢歌的最后一个音符渐渐消散。

abstract.en: Picture a wilted flower drooping in a cracked cup.
abstract.cn: 想象一朵枯萎的花垂在有裂纹的杯中。

examples.en: The ending of the film made everyone sad.
examples.cn: 电影的结局让每个人都很难过。

examples.en: It is sad to see the old school empty.
examples.cn: 看到老学校空无一人，令人伤感。

examples.en: Sadly, the train had already left when we arrived.
examples.cn: 遗憾的是，我们到达时火车已经开走了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「赛的」——输了比赛的人自然难过；sad 读音近似「赛的（输了）」

root: 源自日耳曼语词根 *sadas（饱足），古英语 sæd 意为饱足、倦怠，经「坚定、严肃」于中古英语后期转为「忧愁」，与 satisfy 远亲相关。

sensesIntro.en: Sad moves from feeling sorrow, to events that cause pity, to anything disgracefully poor, to dull faded colors.
sensesIntro.cn: sad 从悲伤的心情出发，到令人惋惜的事，再到糟糕的惨状与黯淡的色调。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a heavy heart pulling the face downward
core.cn: 核心意象：沉重的心把嘴角拉向下方

branches.en: Sorrow felt inside is the base image.
branches.cn: 内心的哀愁是这个词的基础画面。

branches.en: What pours sorrow into others is called sad as well.
branches.cn: 把哀愁灌注给他人的事也同样称为 sad。

branches.en: Pity for a person becomes scorn for a state that fails.
branches.cn: 对人的怜悯转变为对惨状的惋惜。

branches.en: Low spirits drain the color out of rooms and coats.
branches.cn: 低落的情绪抽走了房间与外套的颜色。

branches.en: A shabby defense and a grey wall are sad in the same way.
branches.cn: 惨淡的防守与灰暗的墙以同样的方式显得 sad。

intro.en: Sad builds a small family of feeling words.
intro.cn: sad 构成一个小小的情绪词族。

latinIntro.en: Sad is a Germanic word without Latin relatives.
latinIntro.cn: sad 属日耳曼语源词，没有拉丁同族词。

items.example: Sadly, the concert was cancelled.
items.exampleCN: 遗憾的是，音乐会取消了。

items.example: There was deep sadness in her voice.
items.exampleCN: 她的声音里有深深的哀伤。

items.example: The bad news saddened the whole team.
items.exampleCN: 坏消息让全队都沮丧了。

items.example: She wrote to share the sad news.
items.exampleCN: 她来信告知噩耗。

items.meaning: a story with an unhappy ending
items.example: The film is a sad story of lost love.
items.exampleCN: 这部电影是一个关于失去爱情的悲伤故事。

items.example: Sad to say, he never returned home.
items.exampleCN: 遗憾的是，他再也没有回过家。

items.example: The garden is in a sad state after the storm.
items.exampleCN: 暴风雨后花园一片狼藉。

items.meaningCN: 笨手笨脚、不成器的人（俚语）
items.example: He played the sad sack in every comedy.
items.exampleCN: 他在每部喜剧里都扮演那个倒霉蛋。

items.meaning: having learned from a painful experience
items.meaningCN: 吃一堑长一智；经事长智
items.example: He came back sadder but wiser.
items.exampleCN: 他回来时多了份伤感，也多了份清醒。

items.meaning: having a sorrowful look in the eyes
items.example: The sad-eyed dog waited at the gate.
items.exampleCN: 那只眼神哀伤的狗在门口等候。

definition_zh: 安全的；稳妥的；保险箱；安然无恙的
definition_en: not in danger or not likely to cause harm, or a strong box for keeping valuables
core_image: 一扇锁牢的铁门，把危险挡在外面
scene: 过马路前她左右看了看才迈步。The children waited until the road was safe before crossing.
sceneCN: 这里 safe 是「安全的」（第 1 个义项：没有危险）；句意：孩子们等到路上安全了才过马路。

pos.zh: 安全的；稳妥的；无损的
保险箱；冷藏柜

collocations.zh: 稳妥的一边（on the safe side）

derivatives.zh: 由形容词加 -ly 后缀构成，义为「安全地；稳妥地」
由形容词加 -ty 后缀构成，义为「安全；安全性」
由 safe 加 guard 构成，义为「保护；保障」

senses.title: Not in danger
senses.definition: not in danger, and not likely to hurt anyone or anything
senses.definitionCN: 没有危险，也不会造成伤害
senses.example: The water is safe to drink after boiling.
senses.exampleCN: 水烧开后就可以安全饮用了。
senses.why: A locked door keeps harm outside, which is the oldest picture of safety.
senses.whyCN: 锁牢的门把危险挡在外面，正是「安全」最古老的画面。

senses.title: Not harmed or lost
senses.definition: having come through danger without being hurt or lost
senses.definitionCN: 经历危险后没有受伤或遗失
senses.example: All the climbers returned safe and sound.
senses.exampleCN: 所有登山者都平安归来。
senses.why: The one who stays inside the locked door comes out untouched.
senses.whyCN: 待在门内的人走出来时毫发无损。

senses.title: Cautious and reliable
senses.definition: careful and not taking risks, or certain to give a good result
senses.definitionCN: 谨慎不冒险，或必定带来好结果
senses.example: She plays it safe and checks the weather twice.
senses.exampleCN: 她行事求稳，把天气预报查了两遍。
senses.why: Choosing the locked door over the open one is caution turned into habit.
senses.whyCN: 宁选上锁之门而不冒险，谨慎由此化为习惯。

senses.title: A strong box for valuables
senses.definition: a strong metal box with a lock, used for keeping money and valuable things
senses.definitionCN: 带锁的坚固金属柜，用于存放钱与贵重物品
senses.example: The jewels were locked inside the hotel safe.
senses.exampleCN: 珠宝锁在酒店的保险箱里。
senses.why: The thing that keeps harm out becomes a box that keeps thieves out.
senses.whyCN: 挡住危险之物，化身挡住窃贼的柜子。

intro.en: Safe comes from Latin salvus, meaning whole and unharmed, through Old French sauf.
intro.cn: safe 经古法语 sauf 来自拉丁语 salvus，意为完整无伤。

items.en: Salvus means whole, saved, and unharmed, the root also seen in salvo and salvation.
items.cn: 拉丁语 salvus 意为完整、得救、无伤，salvo 与 salvation 亦出此根。

items.en: Old French carried the word as sauf and safeguard as sauve garde.
items.cn: 古法语承袭为 sauf，safeguard 亦源自其短语 sauve garde。

items.en: Safe entered English meaning unharmed and out of danger.
items.cn: safe 进入英语时意为无伤、脱离危险。

items.en: The noun safe, a lockable box, arose from the adjective's promise of protection.
items.cn: 十五世纪名词「保险箱」由形容词的保护之义发展而来。

items.en: Safe now covers danger, health, caution, and security boxes alike.
items.cn: 今天 safe 兼指脱离危险、平安健康、谨慎稳妥与保险箱。

note.en: Safe has look-alike family words and near-meaning words about protection and caution.
note.cn: safe 的形近词多属同族，近义词集中在保护与谨慎的义场。

entries.definition: the state of being safe
entries.definitionCN: 安全；安全性，safe 的名词形式

entries.definition: to rescue someone from harm; to keep money
entries.definitionCN: 拯救；储蓄，与 safe 同出拉丁语 salvus，读音相近

entries.definition: wild and violent
entries.definitionCN: 野蛮的；凶猛的，与 safe 仅差两个字母，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: safe from attack or loss; firmly fixed
entries.definitionCN: 牢固的；有保障的，强调防护措施到位

entries.definition: not able to cause harm
entries.definitionCN: 无害的，只指不伤人，不指脱离危险

entries.definition: kept safe by someone or something
entries.definitionCN: 受保护的，强调有守护者在，safe 则指状态本身

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember safe through locks and rescue.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕锁与拯救的记忆路径。

normal.en: SAFE and SAVE share the root: what saves you keeps you safe.
normal.cn: SAFE 与 SAVE 同根：救你之物即护你之物。

normal.en: A SAFE is a safe place for your gold.
normal.cn: 保险箱（safe）就是黄金的 safe 之所。

normal.en: Safe and SOUND: sound here means whole, not noise.
normal.cn: safe and sound 里的 sound 意为「完好」，不是声音。

normal.en: Play it SAFE: check twice, cross once.
normal.cn: play it safe：查两遍，过一次。

normal.en: The bank vault is the biggest safe in town.
normal.cn: 银行金库是镇上最大的保险箱。

abstract.en: See a heavy iron door close with a solid click.
abstract.cn: 看厚重的铁门「咔哒」一声锁上。

abstract.en: Feel the boat reach the harbor after the storm.
abstract.cn: 感受小船在风暴后驶入港湾的安稳。

abstract.en: Picture a child holding a parent's hand at the crossing.
abstract.cn: 想象过马路时孩子紧紧牵着大人的手。

examples.en: Keep your passport in a safe place.
examples.cn: 把护照放在安全的地方。

examples.en: Everyone arrived safe and sound after the long drive.
examples.cn: 长途驱车之后大家平安抵达。

examples.en: The code for the office safe has been changed.
examples.cn: 办公室保险箱的密码已经更换。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「速夫」——快速把门锁上的丈夫，让家人安全；safe 读音近似「速夫」

root: 源自拉丁语 salvus（完整无伤），经古法语 sauf 进入英语；与 save、salvation 同根，「安全」「平安」「保险箱」诸义皆由「完整无伤」生出。

sensesIntro.en: Safe moves from danger kept outside, to coming through unharmed, to cautious choices, to the locked box itself.
sensesIntro.cn: safe 从挡住危险出发，到平安归来、行事求稳，最后落地为保险箱本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a closed door that keeps harm outside
core.cn: 核心意象：一扇把危险关在外面的门

branches.en: No danger inside the door is the base image.
branches.cn: 门内无险是这个词的基础画面。

branches.en: Coming out of danger untouched proves the door worked.
branches.cn: 毫发无损地走出危险，证明门起了作用。

branches.en: Choosing the locked door over the open one is caution.
branches.cn: 舍开门而取锁门，便是谨慎。

branches.en: A box that keeps thieves out is safety turned into furniture.
branches.cn: 挡住窃贼的柜子是「安全」化为的一件家具。

branches.en: Safe and sound travelers and locked jewels share one door.
branches.cn: 平安的旅人与锁好的珠宝共享同一扇门。

intro.en: Safe builds a wide family around protection and rescue.
intro.cn: safe 围绕保护与拯救构成庞大的词族。

latinIntro.en: Safe comes from Latin salvus, so it has Latin-rooted relatives like save and salvation.
latinIntro.cn: safe 来自拉丁语 salvus，故有 save、salvation 等拉丁同根词。

items.example: The plane landed safely in the fog.
items.exampleCN: 飞机在雾中安全降落。

items.example: Wear a helmet for safety.
items.exampleCN: 为安全起见请戴头盔。

items.example: New laws safeguard consumer rights.
items.exampleCN: 新法律保障消费者权益。

items.meaning: to rescue; to keep for later
items.example: The lifeguard saved the swimmer.
items.exampleCN: 救生员救起了溺水者。

items.example: The lost hikers were found safe and sound.
items.exampleCN: 迷路的远足者被找到时安然无恙。

items.example: The library is a safe haven for students.
items.exampleCN: 图书馆是学生的避风港。

items.example: Take an umbrella to be on the safe side.
items.exampleCN: 稳妥起见带把伞吧。

items.example: The agent hid in a safe house.
items.exampleCN: 特工藏身于一处安全屋。

items.meaning: being saved from harm or sin
items.example: They saw the vaccine as their salvation.
items.exampleCN: 他们把疫苗视为救星。

items.example: The bank installed two new safes.
items.exampleCN: 银行新装了两台保险箱。

sceneCN: 这里 safety 是「安全」（第 1 个义项：免受危险或伤害的状态）；句意：为了您的安全，在工地上请佩戴安全帽。

pos.zh: 安全；安全性；安全措施；保险装置

senses.title: The state of being safe
senses.definition: the condition of being protected from danger, harm, or loss
senses.definitionCN: 免受危险、伤害或损失的状态
senses.example: The crew reached the shore in safety.
senses.exampleCN: 船员们平安抵达岸边。
senses.why: The adjective safe turns into a noun: the condition itself gets a name.
senses.whyCN: 形容词 safe 名词化，状态本身由此得名。

senses.title: Devices that prevent accidents
senses.definition: a device designed to prevent accidents, such as a safety catch on a gun
senses.definitionCN: 防止事故发生的装置，如枪上的保险栓
senses.example: He flicked off the safety before cleaning the rifle.
senses.exampleCN: 擦枪前他先关掉了保险。
senses.why: A thing that makes you safe is named by the state it produces.
senses.whyCN: 让人安全之物，便以它造就的状态命名。

senses.title: Measures and rules for protection
senses.definition: the set of rules and actions taken to keep people safe
senses.definitionCN: 为保障人身安全而采取的规则与行动
senses.example: The factory improved its safety standards last year.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂去年提高了安全标准。
senses.why: The state of safety spreads to the systems that produce it.
senses.whyCN: 「安全」状态延伸到生产这一状态的制度与做法。

intro.en: Safety comes from safe plus the noun suffix -ty, from Latin salvus through Old French sauf.
intro.cn: safety 由 safe 加名词后缀 -ty 构成，词根经古法语 sauf 上溯至拉丁语 salvus。

items.en: Salvus means whole and unharmed, the same root as safe.
items.cn: 拉丁语 salvus 意为完整无伤，与 safe 同根。

items.en: Old French sauf gave English the adjective safe.
items.cn: 古法语 sauf 为英语提供了形容词 safe。

items.en: Safety formed in English from safe plus -ty, a learned noun suffix.
items.cn: safety 在英语内部由 safe 加学术性后缀 -ty 构成。

items.en: Early uses spoke of rescue and being kept from harm.
items.cn: 十四世纪初期的用法多指获救与免于伤害。

items.cn: 工业时代为该词添入保险装置、安全带与安全规程等用法。

entries.definition: health, happiness, and well-being

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember safety through belts, locks, and rules.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕安全带、锁与规程的记忆路径。

normal.en: SAFETY = SAFE + TY: the state of being safe.
normal.cn: SAFETY 就是 SAFE 加名词尾巴——「安全」这个状态本身。

normal.en: Safety FIRST: put the helmet on before anything else.
normal.cn: 安全第一：先戴好头盔再干活。

normal.en: Fasten your SAFETY belt before the car moves.
normal.cn: 汽车开动前先系好安全带。

normal.en: The gun SAFETY is a small lock that stops accidents.
normal.cn: 枪上的保险（safety）是一道防事故的小锁。

normal.en: Safety REGULATIONS are rules written in place of luck.
normal.cn: 安全规程：把运气换成成文的规则。

abstract.en: See a guardrail standing firm at the cliff edge.
abstract.cn: 看护栏在悬崖边稳稳立着。

abstract.en: Hear the click of a seat belt buckling shut.
abstract.cn: 听安全带扣合的一声脆响。

abstract.en: Picture a child asleep between watchful parents.
abstract.cn: 想象孩子在警醒的父母之间安然入睡。

examples.en: The new bridge was built with safety in mind.
examples.cn: 新桥的设计充分考虑了安全。

examples.en: For your own safety, stay behind the yellow line.
examples.cn: 为了自身安全，请站在黄线之后。

examples.en: The airline has an excellent safety record.
examples.cn: 这家航空公司有着出色的安全记录。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「顺利贴」——一路顺利，稳稳贴着安全带；safety 读音近似「顺利贴」

root: 由形容词 safe（源自拉丁语 salvus，完整无伤）加名词后缀 -ty 在英语内部构成；安全状态、保险装置与安全规程诸义皆由「免于伤害」生出。

sensesIntro.en: Safety moves from the state of being unharmed, to devices that prevent accidents, to the rules that protect people.
sensesIntro.cn: safety 从免受伤害的状态出发，到防事故的装置，再到保护人的规程。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steady zone behind the guardrail
core.cn: 核心意象：护栏之内的一片安稳地带

branches.en: Being out of harm's way is the base state.
branches.cn: 置身危险之外是这个词的基础状态。

branches.en: A device that produces the state takes the state's name.
branches.cn: 造就安全状态的装置以该状态命名。

branches.en: Rules are safety written down in advance.
branches.cn: 规程是把安全预先写成文字。

branches.en: Belts and regulations both block accidents before they happen.
branches.cn: 安全带与安全规程都在事故发生前设障。

branches.en: Rescue ends in safety; safety begins where danger ends.
branches.cn: 救援止于安全；安全始于危险终结之处。

intro.en: Safety forms compounds with belts, pins, and rules.
intro.cn: safety 与安全带、保险销、规程等构成大量复合词。

latinIntro.en: Safety is built in English on Latin salvus through safe, so it has Latin-rooted relatives.
latinIntro.cn: safety 在英语内建于 safe（源自拉丁语 salvus）之上，故有拉丁同根词。

items.meaning: a belt that holds you in a vehicle
items.example: Fasten your safety belt before takeoff.
items.exampleCN: 起飞前请系好安全带。

items.meaning: a pin with a protective cover over its point
items.example: She fixed the strap with a safety pin.
items.exampleCN: 她用安全别针固定好带子。

items.example: All workers must learn the safety regulations.
items.exampleCN: 所有工人都必须学习安全规程。

items.example: The airline boasts a perfect safety record.
items.exampleCN: 这家航空公司以完美的安全记录自豪。

items.meaning: a net to catch falling people; a financial backup
items.example: Savings are your safety net in hard times.
items.exampleCN: 存款是困难时期的保障。

items.meaning: safety is the most important thing
items.example: Safety first: goggles on before cutting.
items.exampleCN: 安全第一：切割前先戴护目镜。

items.example: The road was closed for safety reasons.
items.exampleCN: 出于安全考虑，道路封闭了。

items.meaning: a device that stops a machine or gun firing
items.example: He engaged the safety catch on the ladder.
items.exampleCN: 他扣好了梯子上的保险卡扣。

items.example: They crossed the river safely.
items.exampleCN: 他们安全渡过了河。

items.example: The villagers sheltered in safety underground.
items.exampleCN: 村民们在地下安全避难。
