definition_zh: 帆；航行；启航；乘船游览
definition_en: a large piece of cloth that catches wind to move a boat, or to travel on water in a boat
core_image: 一面吃满风的白帆，推着船在水面滑行
scene: 海风正劲，帆船鼓着帆驶出了港湾。The white sail caught the wind and pushed the boat out of the harbor.
sceneCN: 这里 sail 是「帆」（第 1 个义项：借助风力推动船的布篷）；句意：白帆吃满风，把船送出港湾。

pos.zh: 帆；帆船；航行
航行；启航；驾驶（帆船）；轻快地走

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -or 后缀构成，指「水手；乘船者」
由动词加 -ing 转名词，义为「帆船运动；航行」
由 sail 加 board 构成，义为「帆板」

senses.title: A cloth that catches wind
senses.definition: a large piece of strong cloth fixed to a boat to catch the wind and move it forward
senses.definitionCN: 固定在船上、借风力推动船前行的大块坚固布篷
senses.example: They raised the sail as soon as the wind rose.
senses.exampleCN: 风一起，他们便扬起了帆。
senses.why: A wing of cloth spread against the sky is the oldest tool of travel by water.
senses.whyCN: 在天空下张开的一面布翼，是最古老的水上动力。

senses.title: To travel on water
senses.definition: to travel on water in a boat or ship, especially one moved by sails
senses.definitionCN: 乘船在水面行进，尤指帆船
senses.example: We sailed down the coast for three days.
senses.exampleCN: 我们沿海岸向南航行了三天。
senses.why: The tool gives its name to the whole journey it makes possible.
senses.whyCN: 工具之名顺势指代它成就的整段旅程。

senses.title: To begin a voyage
senses.definition: to leave a port and begin a journey by sea
senses.definitionCN: 驶离港口开始海上旅程
senses.example: The ferry sails at noon every day.
senses.exampleCN: 渡轮每天中午启航。
senses.why: One word covers the whole trip, including its first moment of departure.
senses.whyCN: 一个词覆盖整段旅程，也包括离港的那一刻。

senses.title: To move smoothly and proudly
senses.definition: to move in a smooth, graceful, or confident way, as if carried by wind
senses.definitionCN: 像被风托着一样平稳、轻盈或自信地移动
senses.example: She sailed into the room without a glance at anyone.
senses.exampleCN: 她神态自若地走进房间，看都不看任何人一眼。
senses.why: A ship under full sail glides without effort, so gliding people sail too.
senses.whyCN: 满帆的船不费力地滑行，滑行的人也因此被说成 sail。

intro.en: Sail comes from Old English segl, a wind-catching cloth, of Germanic origin.
intro.cn: sail 源自古英语 segl（乘风之布），属日耳曼语源。

items.en: The Germanic root *segl- named the wind-catching cloth of early boats.
items.cn: 一般认为日耳曼语词根 *segl- 指早期船只上兜风的布篷。

items.en: Segl meant the cloth; the verb siGLIAN meant to travel by it.
items.cn: 古英语 segl 指帆，动词 siGLIAN 指借助帆出行。

items.en: Sail kept both noun and verb through the age of exploration.
items.cn: 大航海时代，sail 的名动两义并行不废。

items.en: Steam ships kept the verb sail even when wind was gone.
items.cn: 蒸汽船时代虽无风帆，动词 sail 却保留了下来。

items.en: Sail now also glides across rooms and election campaigns.
items.cn: 如今 sail 也滑行于房间与竞选行程之间，喻指从容自信的移动。

note.en: Sail has look-alike words of different origin and near-meaning words about sea travel.
note.cn: sail 的形近词多属异源，近义词集中在海上出行义场。

entries.definition: a person who works or travels on ships
entries.definitionCN: 水手；船员，sail 加 -or 的同根派生词

entries.definition: the act of selling something at a lower price
entries.definitionCN: 出售；廉价销售，读音与 sail 完全相同，词源无关，只能靠语境区分

entries.definition: the back part of an animal's body
entries.definitionCN: 尾巴，与 sail 仅差首字母，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: to sail slowly for pleasure, often on a large ship
entries.definitionCN: 乘游轮巡游，强调休闲慢速航行

entries.definition: a long journey by sea or in space
entries.definitionCN: 航程；长途旅行，指整段旅程而非动作

entries.definition: a boat used for racing or pleasure sailing
entries.definitionCN: 帆船；游艇，指船本身而非航行动作

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember sail through wind and water.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕风与水的记忆路径。

normal.en: SAIL and SALE sound the same: one catches wind, one catches buyers.
normal.cn: SAIL 与 SALE 同音：一个兜风，一个兜顾客。

normal.en: SET SAIL means start: the cloth goes up, the trip begins.
normal.cn: set sail 即出发：帆升起，旅程开始。

normal.en: A boat with a SAIL needs no engine, only wind.
normal.cn: 有帆的船不需要引擎，只要风。

normal.en: She SAILS through exams: smooth, fast, no waves.
normal.cn: 她考试如行云流水（sail through）：又快又稳不起波澜。

normal.en: SAILORS live where the wind meets the water.
normal.cn: 水手（sailor）常年生活在风与水交界的地方。

abstract.en: Feel the deck tilt as the wind fills the cloth above you.
abstract.cn: 感受风灌满头顶布帆时甲板的倾斜。

abstract.en: See a ship glide out of the harbor without a sound.
abstract.cn: 看一艘船悄然滑出港湾。

abstract.en: Watch a gull drift on the same wind that drives the sail.
abstract.cn: 看海鸥借着推动船帆的同一阵风滑翔。

examples.en: The captain ordered the crew to lower the sails.
examples.cn: 船长命令船员降下船帆。

examples.en: They plan to sail from Athens to Venice.
examples.cn: 他们计划从雅典航行到威尼斯。

examples.en: He sailed through the interview without difficulty.
examples.cn: 他轻松顺利地通过了面试。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「随鸥」——帆影随海鸥远去；sail 读音近似「随鸥」

root: 源自日耳曼语词根 *segl-（乘风之布），古英语 segl 直承此义；帆、航行、启航诸义一体，轻快移动义则由满帆滑行的画面喻指而来。

sensesIntro.en: Sail moves from the wind-catching cloth, to voyages on water, to the moment of departure, to graceful gliding movement.
sensesIntro.cn: sail 从兜风的布篷出发，到水上航行、启航时刻，再到如满帆滑行般的轻盈步伐。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cloth wing filled with wind
core.cn: 核心意象：一面被风灌满的布翼

branches.en: The cloth that catches wind is the base object.
branches.cn: 兜风的布篷是这个词的基础物象。

branches.en: The tool names the travel it enables.
branches.cn: 工具之名指代它成就的航行。

branches.en: Setting sail is just the first moment of sailing.
branches.cn: 启航不过是航行的第一个瞬间。

branches.en: A ship glides under full sail; gliding people sail too.
branches.cn: 满帆的船平稳滑行，滑行的人同样在 sail。

branches.en: Wind fills the sail and carries both ships and confident walkers.
branches.cn: 风灌满布帆，托起船，也托起自信的步伐。

intro.en: Sail builds compounds around ships, wind, and travel.
intro.cn: sail 的构词围绕船只、风与旅程展开。

latinIntro.en: Sail is a Germanic word without Latin relatives, so no Latin entries are listed.
latinIntro.cn: sail 属日耳曼语源词，没有拉丁同族词，故不列拉丁词条。

items.meaning: a person who works on a ship
items.example: The sailor tied the rope to the mast.
items.exampleCN: 水手把绳索系上桅杆。

items.meaning: the sport or activity of using sails
items.example: Sailing is popular on this coast.
items.exampleCN: 帆船运动在这片海岸很流行。

items.example: They set sail at dawn.
items.exampleCN: 他们在黎明启航。

items.meaning: a small board with a sail for windsurfing
items.example: He learned to balance on a sailboard.
items.exampleCN: 他学会了在帆板上保持平衡。

items.meaning: the cloths that catch wind on boats
items.example: The wind filled all the sails.
items.exampleCN: 风灌满了所有船帆。

items.example: She sailed through her driving test.
items.exampleCN: 她轻松通过了驾照考试。

items.meaning: to enter proudly or attack verbally
items.meaningCN: 神气十足地进入；严厉斥责
items.example: He sailed into the meeting five minutes late.
items.exampleCN: 他神气十足地迟了五分钟进入会场。

items.meaning: with all sails spread to the wind
items.example: The ship came round the point under full sail.
items.exampleCN: 船满帆绕过海岬。

items.example: A small sailing boat drifted past the pier.
items.exampleCN: 一艘小帆船漂过码头。

items.meaning: to spread sails and start moving
items.example: The fleet made sail with the morning tide.
items.exampleCN: 船队乘早潮张帆出发。

definition_zh: 缘故；理由；为了……起见（for the sake of）
definition_en: used in the phrase for the sake of to mean for the benefit or purpose of someone or something
core_image: 一枚压在决定上的砝码：为了谁、图个什么
scene: 为了孩子们的健康，她把零食都收了起来。She gave up smoking for the sake of her health.
sceneCN: 这里 sake 是「缘故」（第 1 个义项：for the sake of 表示「为了……的利益」）；句意：为了健康她戒了烟。

pos.zh: 缘故；理由；利益

collocations.zh: 看在上帝的份上（表示不耐烦）

derivatives.zh: 由 for- 加 sake 构成，义为「抛弃；放弃」，同根近亲
sake 的复数形式，见于 for God's sakes 等感叹用法

senses.title: Benefit or purpose
senses.definition: benefit, advantage, or purpose, used in the phrase for the sake of
senses.definitionCN: 用于 for the sake of 短语，指为了某人的利益或某个目的
senses.example: They moved to the countryside for the sake of the children.
senses.exampleCN: 为了孩子们，他们搬到了乡下。
senses.why: A weight laid on the scale of a decision names the reason that tips it.
senses.whyCN: 压在决定天平上的砝码，正是让决定倾斜的那个「缘故」。

senses.title: In emphatic requests
senses.definition: used in phrases like for God's sake or for heaven's sake to show strong feeling
senses.definitionCN: 用于 for God's sake 等短语，表示强烈情绪或不耐烦
senses.example: For heaven's sake, stop tapping the table!
senses.exampleCN: 看在老天的份上，别再敲桌子了！
senses.why: Calling on the highest witness strengthens a plea like a stamp on a letter.
senses.whyCN: 请出最高的见证者，如同在信上盖章，让请求更有分量。

senses.title: For its own value alone
senses.titleCN: 就其本身而言（for its own sake）
senses.definition: for its own value without any other purpose, used in for its own sake
senses.definitionCN: 在 for its own sake 中指不为别的目的，只为事物本身
senses.example: He collects stamps for their own sake, not for money.
senses.exampleCN: 他集邮纯粹出于爱好，并非为了钱。
senses.why: When the reason is the thing itself, the weight rests on nothing outside it.
senses.whyCN: 当缘故就是事物本身时，砝码便不再依赖任何外物。

intro.en: Sake comes from Old English sacu, a matter, cause, or dispute, of Germanic origin.
intro.cn: sake 源自古英语 sacu（事由、缘由、争端），属日耳曼语源。

items.en: The Germanic root *sak- meant a matter, a charge, or a legal dispute.
items.cn: 一般认为日耳曼语词根 *sak- 指事情、指控或法律争端，与 seek 同源相关。

items.en: Sacu meant a quarrel, a cause, or a matter at stake.
items.cn: 古英语 sacu 兼指争端、缘由与利害攸关之事。

items.en: Sake narrowed to mean cause or purpose in the phrase for someone's sake.
items.cn: 中古英语时期词义收窄，在 for someone's sake 中专指缘由与目的。

items.en: For God's sake became a fixed emphatic phrase.
items.cn: 十六至十七世纪，for God's sake 固化为加强语气的习语。

items.en: Sake now lives almost entirely inside set phrases.
items.cn: 如今 sake 几乎只活在固定短语之中，单独使用已很少见。

note.en: Sake has look-alike words from the same root and near-meaning words about purpose.
note.cn: sake 的形近词多属同根，近义词集中在目的与缘由义场。

entries.definition: to leave someone or something behind completely
entries.definitionCN: 抛弃；离弃，与 sake 同出古英语 sacu 一族

entries.definition: to move quickly up and down or side to side
entries.definitionCN: 摇动；颤抖，与 sake 仅差首字母，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: a large area of water surrounded by land
entries.definitionCN: 湖，与 sake 韵母相同，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: an advantage or good result
entries.definitionCN: 益处；好处，指具体收益，sake 多用于固定短语

entries.definition: the reason something happens; a principle one supports
entries.definitionCN: 原因；事业，与 sake 古义相近，今多指原因或事业

entries.definition: advantage or benefit, especially of a group
entries.definitionCN: 利益（尤指群体的），in the interest of 与 for the sake of 相近

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember sake through reasons and phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕缘由与固定短语的记忆路径。

normal.en: SAKE is the reason that tips the scale of a decision.
normal.cn: SAKE 是让决定的天平倾斜的那颗砝码——缘故。

normal.en: For the SAKE of peace: give a little, gain much.
normal.cn: 为了和平起见：让三分，得全局。

normal.en: For God's SAKE: call the biggest witness to your plea.
normal.cn: for God's sake：请出最大的见证者为请求作保。

normal.en: Art for art's SAKE needs no buyer, no prize.
normal.cn: 为艺术而艺术，不需要买家，也不需要奖项。

normal.en: FORSAKE someone is to leave them for another sake.
normal.cn: forsake（抛弃）一个人，就是「为了别的缘故」离开他。

abstract.en: See one small stone tip a whole balance.
abstract.cn: 看一枚小石子压斜了整架天平。

abstract.en: Hear a sigh before someone agrees for a friend's sake.
abstract.cn: 听一声轻叹——为朋友才勉强答应。

abstract.en: Picture a painter working with no buyer in mind.
abstract.cn: 想象一位画家作画时心中并无买家。

examples.en: Let's not argue for the sake of the project.
examples.cn: 为了项目着想，我们别争了。

examples.en: For safety's sake, everyone must wear a mask here.
examples.cn: 为安全起见，在这里人人都必须戴口罩。

examples.en: He does charity work for its own sake, not for praise.
examples.cn: 他做慈善不为名声，只为这件事本身。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「思意克」——凡事先思其意、克服私心，为了大家起见；sake 读音近似「思意克」

root: 源自古英语 sacu（事由、争端），属日耳曼语词根 *sak-（与 seek 相关）；缘由、目的诸义由「利害攸关之事」收窄而来，今几乎只存于固定短语。

sensesIntro.en: Sake moves from a matter at stake, to the benefit that tips a decision, to emphatic pleas, to things valued for themselves.
sensesIntro.cn: sake 从利害攸关之事出发，到让决定倾斜的利益、加重语气的恳求，再到只为其自身价值之事。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a weight on the scale of a decision
core.cn: 核心意象：压在决定天平上的一枚砝码

branches.en: The matter that decides an action is the base image.
branches.cn: 决定行动的缘由是这个词的基础画面。

branches.en: A plea gains force by calling on the greatest sake.
branches.cn: 请出最大的「缘故」，恳求便有了分量。

branches.en: For the sake of names the weight that tips the decision.
branches.cn: for the sake of 说出让决定倾斜的那枚砝码。

branches.en: Some weights rest on nothing outside the thing itself.
branches.cn: 有些砝码不依赖外物，只以事物本身为凭。

branches.en: Forsaking someone means choosing another sake over them.
branches.cn: 抛弃一个人，就是选了别的缘故而舍弃他。

intro.en: Sake lives almost entirely inside set phrases.
intro.cn: sake 几乎只以固定短语的形式存在。

latinIntro.en: Sake is a Germanic word without Latin relatives, so no Latin entries are listed.
latinIntro.cn: sake 属日耳曼语源词，没有拉丁同族词，故不列拉丁词条。

items.meaning: for the benefit or purpose of
items.example: He stayed quiet for the sake of peace.
items.exampleCN: 为了息事宁人，他保持了沉默。

items.meaningCN: 看在上帝的份上（表不耐烦）
items.example: For God's sake, be careful!
items.exampleCN: 看在上帝的份上，小心点！

items.example: For heaven's sake, turn the music down.
items.exampleCN: 求你了，把音乐调小点。

items.example: For safety's sake, check the ladder twice.
items.exampleCN: 为安全起见，梯子要检查两遍。

items.example: They met for old times' sake.
items.exampleCN: 他们为了怀旧之情见了面。

items.meaning: for the value of the thing itself
items.meaningCN: 为事物本身；不为其他目的
items.example: She learns languages for their own sake.
items.exampleCN: 她学语言纯粹出于爱好。

items.meaning: art that needs no other purpose
items.example: The movement believed in art for art's sake.
items.exampleCN: 这一流派信奉为艺术而艺术。

items.example: Never forsake a friend in trouble.
items.exampleCN: 绝不抛弃患难中的朋友。

items.meaningCN: 看在善意的份上（较温和的感叹）
items.example: For goodness' sake, hurry up!
items.exampleCN: 拜托，快点吧！

items.meaning: only to follow the proper procedure
items.meaningCN: 为了走形式；例行公事地
items.example: He apologized for form's sake only.
items.exampleCN: 他道歉只是走个形式。

definition_zh: 沙拉；凉拌菜；生菜类蔬菜
definition_en: a cold dish of mixed raw vegetables, or mixed foods served with a dressing
core_image: 一只大碗里切碎拌好的新鲜生食
scene: 午餐时她做了一大碗蔬菜沙拉。She made a large vegetable salad for lunch.
sceneCN: 这里 salad 是「沙拉」（第 1 个义项：生蔬菜拌成的冷盘）；句意：她午餐拌了一大碗蔬菜沙拉。

pos.zh: 沙拉；凉拌菜；（美）生菜类蔬菜

collocations.zh: 青涩年华；少不更事的岁月

derivatives.zh: 由 salad 加 cream 构成，义为「沙拉酱（英式）」
由 salad 加 greens 构成，义为「做沙拉用的绿叶菜」

senses.title: A cold dish of raw vegetables
senses.definition: a cold dish of mixed raw vegetables, often with a dressing of oil or sauce
senses.definitionCN: 生蔬菜拌成的冷盘，常浇油或酱汁调味
senses.example: The salad is made of tomatoes, cucumbers, and lettuce.
senses.exampleCN: 这份沙拉由番茄、黄瓜和生菜拌成。
senses.why: Salted raw vegetables, chopped and mixed, keep the old name of their seasoning.
senses.whyCN: 切碎拌匀、加盐调味的生蔬菜，把「盐渍」这个古老的词留在名中。

senses.title: A cold dish of other mixed foods
senses.definition: a cold dish of mixed foods such as fruit, chicken, eggs, or potatoes with sauce
senses.definitionCN: 水果、鸡肉、鸡蛋或土豆等拌酱汁而成的冷盘
senses.example: We ordered a chicken salad and two soups.
senses.exampleCN: 我们点了一份鸡肉沙拉和两份汤。
senses.why: The name of the vegetable dish spreads to every cold mixed dish.
senses.whyCN: 蔬菜冷盘之名扩展到一切冷拌混食。

senses.title: Raw green vegetables
senses.definition: raw green vegetables such as lettuce, eaten in salads, used in American English
senses.definitionCN: 美式英语中指做沙拉用的生菜类蔬菜
senses.example: The store sells fresh salad by the bag.
senses.exampleCN: 这家商店按袋出售新鲜生菜。
senses.why: The dish lends its name to the vegetables that fill it.
senses.whyCN: 菜名反指盛进碗里的那些蔬菜。

intro.en: Salad comes through Old French salade from Latin salata, meaning salted, from sal, salt.
intro.cn: salad 经古法语 salade 来自拉丁语 salata（加盐的），词根 sal 意为盐。

items.en: Sal means salt, the root also seen in salt, sauce, and salary.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sal 意为盐，salt、sauce、salary 皆出此根。

items.en: Herba salata meant salted herbs, the first salads of Rome.
items.cn: herba salata（加盐的香草）是罗马人最早的沙拉。

items.en: Old French carried the word as salade into England.
items.cn: 古法语将该词承袭为 salade 并传入英格兰。

items.en: Salad entered English in the fourteenth century for salted raw greens.
items.cn: 十四世纪 salad 进入英语，指加盐的生蔬。

items.en: Salad now covers vegetables, fruits, meats, and even pasta mixes.
items.cn: 如今 salad 覆盖蔬菜、水果、肉类乃至意面冷盘。

note.en: Salad has look-alike words from the salt root and near-meaning words about cold dishes.
note.cn: salad 的形近词多与「盐」词根相关，近义词集中在冷盘义场。

entries.definition: money paid regularly for work
entries.definitionCN: 薪水，与 salad 同出拉丁语 sal（盐），罗马士兵曾领盐饷

entries.definition: a sauce poured over salad
entries.definitionCN: 沙拉酱，salad 的常见搭配合成词

entries.definition: firm and hard; not liquid or gas
entries.definitionCN: 固体的；结实的，与 salad 仅差几字母，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: a salad of shredded cabbage with dressing
entries.definitionCN: 凉拌卷心菜丝，特指卷心菜冷盘，是 salad 的一种

entries.definition: a small dish eaten before the main course
entries.definitionCN: 开胃菜，指正餐前的菜，salad 常充当此角色

entries.definition: green leafy vegetables
entries.definitionCN: 绿叶菜，泛指菜叶本身，salad greens 则特指拌菜用叶

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember salad through salt and fresh bowls.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕盐与鲜碗的记忆路径。

normal.en: SALAD carries SAL, Latin for salt: Romans salted their greens.
normal.cn: SALAD 里的 SAL 就是拉丁语「盐」：罗马人往菜叶上撒盐。

normal.en: SALAD and SALARY both come from salt: one for the bowl, one for the purse.
normal.cn: salad 与 salary 同出「盐」：一个进碗，一个进钱包。

normal.en: Toss the SALAD: lift and mix like tossing leaves in the wind.
normal.cn: 拌沙拉（toss）：像风翻树叶一样把菜抛起拌匀。

normal.en: SALAD days: the green, unripe season of youth.
normal.cn: salad days：青涩如嫩菜的年少时光。

normal.en: A rainbow in a bowl: that is a good salad.
normal.cn: 碗中彩虹——好沙拉的模样。

abstract.en: Hear the crisp crack of a fresh lettuce leaf.
abstract.cn: 听新鲜生菜叶清脆的断裂声。

abstract.en: See oil and vinegar swirling over green leaves.
abstract.cn: 看油和醋在绿叶上打着旋。

abstract.en: Picture bright red tomatoes against pale cucumber slices.
abstract.cn: 想象鲜红的番茄衬着浅色的黄瓜片。

examples.en: A fresh salad goes well with grilled fish.
examples.cn: 清爽的沙拉配烤鱼正合适。

examples.en: She tossed the salad with olive oil and lemon.
examples.cn: 她用橄榄油和柠檬把沙拉拌匀。

examples.en: In his salad days he knew nothing of hard work.
examples.cn: 少不更事时，他对辛劳一无所知。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「撒拉的」——往菜上撒盐拌一拌；salad 读音近似「撒拉的」

root: 源自拉丁语 sal（盐）的派生词 salata（加盐的），经古法语 salade 于十四世纪进入英语；罗马人加盐生食香草是最早的「沙拉」，与 salary 同根。

sensesIntro.en: Salad moves from salted raw greens, to any cold mixed dish, to the raw green vegetables themselves.
sensesIntro.cn: salad 从加盐的生蔬出发，到一切冷拌混食，最后反指做沙拉的生菜类蔬菜。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bowl of fresh raw things tossed with salt
core.cn: 核心意象：一碗撒了盐拌好的生鲜之物

branches.en: Salted raw greens are the historical base.
branches.cn: 加盐生蔬是这个词的历史底色。

branches.en: Any cold mixed food borrows the bowl's name.
branches.cn: 一切冷拌混食都借走这只碗的名字。

branches.en: The dish name turns back on the vegetables inside it.
branches.cn: 菜名回头指称碗中的蔬菜本身。

branches.en: Fresh greens and chilled plates share the same crispness.
branches.cn: 鲜嫩生菜与冰镇冷盘共享同一份爽脆。

branches.en: Green youth and green leaves share one metaphor.
branches.cn: 青涩年华与青翠菜叶共用一个隐喻。

intro.en: Salad builds compounds around dressings, bowls, and dishes.
intro.cn: salad 的构词围绕酱汁、碗与冷盘展开。

latinIntro.en: Salad comes from Latin sal, so it has salt-rooted relatives like salary and sauce.
latinIntro.cn: salad 来自拉丁语 sal，故有 salary、sauce 等盐词根近亲。

items.example: Which salad dressing would you like?
items.exampleCN: 您要哪种沙拉酱？

items.meaning: a large bowl for serving salad
items.example: She emptied the salad bowl in minutes.
items.exampleCN: 她几分钟就吃光了整碗沙拉。

items.example: Fruit salad is a light summer dessert.
items.exampleCN: 水果沙拉是夏日清淡甜点。

items.meaning: a creamy salad sauce, British style
items.example: He spread salad cream on his sandwich.
items.exampleCN: 他在三明治上抹了沙拉酱。

items.example: Wash the salad greens twice.
items.exampleCN: 把沙拉菜叶洗两遍。

items.meaningCN: 青涩年华；少不更事的岁月
items.example: In my salad days I feared nothing.
items.exampleCN: 年少无知时我天不怕地不怕。

items.meaning: to mix salad by lifting and turning
items.example: Toss the salad just before serving.
items.exampleCN: 上桌前再拌沙拉。

items.meaning: a counter where you build your own salad
items.example: The restaurant has a huge salad bar.
items.exampleCN: 这家餐厅有个超大的沙拉吧。

items.example: A chicken salad makes a quick lunch.
items.exampleCN: 鸡肉沙拉是快捷的午餐。

items.structure: Latin sal- root noun, same family
items.meaningCN: 薪水（同根近亲：罗马士兵的盐饷）
items.example: Her salary is paid on the last Friday monthly.
items.exampleCN: 她的工资每月最后一个周五发放。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 盐（salad 与 salary 的共同词根）

definition_zh: 薪水；薪金；工资
definition_en: a fixed amount of money paid regularly to an employee, usually monthly
core_image: 按时打进的工资：一捧看不见的「盐」
scene: 每月最后一个周五，工资准时到账。His salary is paid into his bank account at the end of each month.
sceneCN: 这里 salary 是「薪水」（第 1 个义项：定期支付的固定报酬）；句意：他的工资每月月底打进银行账户。

pos.zh: 薪水；薪金（通常按月或按年计）

derivatives.zh: 由名词加 -ed 构成，义为「领薪水的；领固定工资的」
由 salaried 加 worker 构成，义为「领薪职工（区别于按件计酬者）」

senses.title: Fixed regular pay for work
senses.definition: a fixed amount of money that an employee receives regularly for their work, usually every month
senses.definitionCN: 雇员因工作定期获得的固定报酬，通常按月发放
senses.example: She earns a good salary as an engineer.
senses.exampleCN: 她做工程师，薪水不错。
senses.why: Money that arrives on a fixed date, like salt once issued to Roman soldiers.
senses.whyCN: 按固定日期到账的钱，正如当年罗马士兵按时领到的盐饷。

senses.title: Pay fixed yearly, not hourly
senses.titleCN: 年薪；固定年薪（与计件相对）
senses.definition: pay agreed as a yearly amount and divided into regular payments, not based on hours
senses.definitionCN: 按年议定、分期支付，不按小时计算的报酬
senses.example: Salaried staff do not get extra pay for overtime.
senses.exampleCN: 领年薪的职员加班没有额外报酬。
senses.why: A yearly lump sum sliced into months fixes both amount and rhythm.
senses.whyCN: 年薪切成按月发放，金额与节奏就此固定。

intro.en: Salary comes from Latin salarium, an allowance for salt, from sal, salt; Roman soldiers were said to receive money to buy salt.
intro.cn: salary 来自拉丁语 salarium（买盐津贴），词根 sal 意为盐；相传罗马士兵领取购盐津贴。

items.en: Sal means salt; salt was once precious and used as money-like goods.
items.cn: 拉丁语 sal 意为盐；盐曾极为珍贵，近乎货币。

items.en: Salarium was the salt allowance paid to soldiers and officials.
items.cn: salarium 指发放给士兵与官员的购盐津贴。

items.en: Old French carried the word as salaire, meaning payment for work.
items.cn: 古法语承袭为 salaire，指劳动报酬。

items.en: Salary entered English meaning fixed payment for service.
items.cn: salary 进入英语，指服务的固定报酬。

items.en: Salary now contrasts with wage: fixed monthly pay versus hourly pay.
items.cn: 如今 salary 与 wage 相对：前者为固定月薪，后者为计时工资。

note.en: Salary has look-alike words from the salt root and near-meaning words about pay.
note.cn: salary 的形近词多与「盐」词根相关，近义词集中在报酬义场。

entries.definition: a cold dish of raw vegetables
entries.definitionCN: 沙拉，与 salary 同出拉丁语 sal（盐）

entries.definition: plural of salary
entries.definitionCN: 薪水（复数），注意复数将 y 变 ies

entries.definition: clean and free from disease
entries.definitionCN: 卫生的，与 salary 拼写部分相同，词源无关，只是形近

entries.definition: money paid for work, usually by the hour or day
entries.definitionCN: （计时/计日）工资，与 salary 相对，按工作量计算

entries.definition: money received for work
entries.definitionCN: 报酬；工资，泛指一切劳动所得

entries.definition: all money received, from work or investments
entries.definitionCN: 收入，范围更广，含租金、利息等

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember salary through Roman salt.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕罗马盐饷的记忆路径。

normal.en: SALARY comes from SAL: Roman soldiers were paid in salt money.
normal.cn: SALARY 来自 SAL（盐）：罗马士兵领的是「盐饷」。

normal.en: SALARY and SALAD share the salt: one seasons food, one seasons life.
normal.cn: salary 与 salad 同享一撮盐：一个调味，一个调生活。

normal.en: Worth one's SALT means worth one's salary.
normal.cn: worth one's salt（称职）就是「配得上自己的薪水」。

normal.en: A SALARY arrives every month like salt on schedule.
normal.cn: 工资按月到账，就像盐按期发放。

normal.en: Not worth his SALT: an employee who fails to earn his pay.
normal.cn: not worth his salt：白拿工资、不胜其任的人。

abstract.en: See white salt grains counted out like coins.
abstract.cn: 看白色盐粒像钱币一样被数出来。

abstract.en: Hear the end-of-month phone buzz of a pay message.
abstract.cn: 听月底手机到账提示的嗡鸣。

abstract.en: Picture a Roman soldier receiving his salt allowance.
abstract.cn: 想象一名罗马士兵领取盐饷的场景。

examples.en: They offered him a higher salary to stay.
examples.cn: 他们开出更高的薪水挽留他。

examples.en: Her annual salary rose by five percent.
examples.cn: 她的年薪涨了百分之五。

examples.en: Salaried employees receive paid holidays.
examples.cn: 领薪职工享有带薪假期。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「撒了利」——工资撒进口袋全是利；salary 读音近似「撒了利」

root: 源自拉丁语 salarium（购盐津贴），词根 sal 意为盐；相传罗马士兵以盐饷计酬，经古法语 salaire 进入英语，今指定期固定薪水。

sensesIntro.en: Salary moves from a salt allowance, to fixed regular pay, to yearly pay divided into months.
sensesIntro.cn: salary 从盐饷出发，到定期固定报酬，再到按月切分的年薪。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: money that arrives on schedule, like salt once issued
core.cn: 核心意象：按期到账的报酬，如旧日按期发放的盐

branches.en: Regular pay is the base image.
branches.cn: 定期报酬是这个词的基础画面。

branches.en: A yearly amount cut into months fixes the rhythm.
branches.cn: 年薪切成按月支付，金额节奏就此固定。

branches.en: Drawing a salary marks you as staff, not piecework.
branches.cn: 领薪水意味着你是职工，而非计件工。

branches.en: Worth your salt and worth your salary are one old equation.
branches.cn: 「配得上盐」与「配得上薪水」是同一个古老的等式。

branches.en: Salt once bought food; salary still buys everything.
branches.cn: 盐曾用来换食物，如今薪水换来一切。

intro.en: Salary forms a small family around fixed pay.
intro.cn: salary 围绕固定报酬构成小词族。

latinIntro.en: Salary comes from Latin salarium, so it has salt-rooted relatives.
latinIntro.cn: salary 来自拉丁语 salarium，故有盐词根近亲。

items.example: Salaried staff get paid leave.
items.exampleCN: 领薪职员享有带薪假。

items.meaning: the total pay for one year
items.example: His annual salary is sixty thousand.
items.exampleCN: 他的年薪是六万。

items.example: Bonuses come on top of the basic salary.
items.exampleCN: 奖金在基本工资之外。

items.meaning: the spread between lowest and highest pay
items.example: The salary range is posted in the ad.
items.exampleCN: 招聘广告里注明了薪资范围。

items.example: He draws a salary from two companies.
items.exampleCN: 他从两家公司领薪。

items.example: Read the guide before salary negotiation.
items.exampleCN: 谈薪前先读读攻略。

items.example: The league sets a salary cap for teams.
items.exampleCN: 联盟为各队设定薪酬上限。

items.structure: Latin sal- direct form, same root
items.example: Add a pinch of salt to the soup.
items.exampleCN: 往汤里加一撮盐。

items.meaningCN: 调味汁（同根近亲：源自「加盐」）
items.example: Tomato sauce goes with pasta.
items.exampleCN: 番茄酱配意面。

items.meaning: a cold dish of raw vegetables
items.meaningCN: 沙拉（同根近亲：加盐的生蔬）
items.example: A green salad freshes up any meal.
items.exampleCN: 一份蔬菜沙拉让任何一餐都清爽起来。

latinEntries.meaningCN: 购盐津贴；固定薪俸（salary 的直接来源）

definition_zh: 出售；销售；廉价销售；销售额
definition_en: the act of selling something, a special period of lower prices, or the amount sold
core_image: 柜台上一手交钱、一手交货的瞬间
scene: 商场橱窗贴出醒目的红色促销海报。Everything in the shop is on sale this weekend.
sceneCN: 这里 sale 是「廉价销售」（第 2 个义项：降价出售的活动）；句意：本周末店里所有商品都降价出售。

pos.zh: 出售；销售；廉价销售；销售额（复数）

derivatives.zh: 由 sale 加 man 构成，义为「推销员；售货员」
由 best 加 seller 构成，义为「畅销书；畅销品」，同族词

senses.title: The act of selling
senses.definition: the act or process of selling something, or an occasion when something is sold
senses.definitionCN: 出售某物的行为或过程，或某物被卖出的场合
senses.example: The sale of the old house took three months.
senses.exampleCN: 老房子花了三个月才卖掉。
senses.why: The moment money meets goods needs a name, and sale is it.
senses.whyCN: 钱货相授的那一刻需要一个名字，sale 便是。

senses.title: A period of lower prices
senses.definition: a special occasion when goods are sold at lower prices than usual
senses.definitionCN: 商品以低于平常价格出售的特定时期
senses.example: The winter sale starts on Boxing Day.
senses.exampleCN: 冬季大减价从节礼日开始。
senses.why: Selling fast means selling cheap: the discount event takes the trade's name.
senses.whyCN: 卖得快就得卖得贱：促销活动沿用了交易之名。

senses.title: The amount of goods sold
senses.definition: the total amount of goods sold, usually in the plural
senses.definitionCN: 售出商品的总量，常用复数
senses.example: Sales rose ten percent after the advertisement.
senses.exampleCN: 广告之后销售额上升了百分之十。
senses.why: Each act of selling adds up, and the sum keeps the singular name in plural form.
senses.whyCN: 一次次出售累积成总量，复数形式仍沿用单数的名字。

senses.title: Availability for purchase
senses.definition: the state of being offered to buyers, used in the phrase for sale
senses.definitionCN: 在 for sale 中表示商品处于可供购买的状态
senses.example: The bicycle in the window is for sale.
senses.exampleCN: 橱窗里的那辆自行车正在出售。
senses.why: A tag in a window tells passersby that the thing will change hands.
senses.whyCN: 橱窗上的标签告诉路人：此物可以易主。

intro.en: Sale comes from Old English salu, the act of selling, related to sell, of Germanic origin.
intro.cn: sale 源自古英语 salu（出售行为），与 sell 同族，属日耳曼语源。

items.en: The Germanic root *sal- meant to give over goods for payment.
items.cn: 一般认为日耳曼语词根 *sal- 意为交货以换取报酬。

items.en: Salu and sellan, to give and to sell, grew from the same root.
items.cn: 古英语 salu 与 sellan（给予、出卖）同根而生。

items.en: Sale named the act of selling before it named discount events.
items.cn: 中古英语时期 sale 先指出售行为，后才指降价活动。

items.en: Shops made sale a regular event, and sales figures entered trade reports.
items.cn: 十七至十九世纪，商家把大减价常态化，销售额也进入商业报表。

items.en: On sale now means both available and discounted.
items.cn: 如今 on sale 兼指「有售」与「降价」，英美用法略有差别。

note.en: Sale has a famous same-sounding look-alike and near-meaning words about selling.
note.cn: sale 有一个著名的同音形近词，近义词集中在销售义场。

entries.definition: a wind-catching cloth; to travel by boat
entries.definitionCN: 帆；航行，与 sale 读音完全相同，词源无关，全靠语境区分

entries.definition: a man whose job is selling things
entries.definitionCN: 推销员；售货员，sale 的派生合成词

entries.definition: to give something in exchange for money
entries.definitionCN: 卖；出售，sale 的同族动词，一为动作一为名词

entries.definition: something bought for less than its usual price
entries.definitionCN: 便宜货；划算的交易，指买方眼中的优惠，sale 指卖方的活动

entries.definition: a reduction in the usual price
entries.definitionCN: 折扣，指减价的幅度，sale 指整个降价活动

entries.definition: a business deal or exchange
entries.definitionCN: 交易，正式用语，兼指买卖双方的整体过程

normalIntro.en: Five ways to remember sale through selling and savings.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕出售与省钱的记忆路径。

normal.en: SALE and SAIL sound the same: a ship sails, a shop has a sale.
normal.cn: SALE 与 SAIL 同音：船在航行（sail），店在打折（sale）。

normal.en: FOR SALE sign: this thing wants a new owner.
normal.cn: for sale 标牌：此物正寻新主。

normal.en: ON SALE: prices drop, wallets smile.
normal.cn: on sale：价格跳水，钱包微笑。

normal.en: SALES figures climb when the sale signs go up.
normal.cn: 促销海报一挂，销售数字就往上爬。

normal.en: Make a SALE, not a sail: close the deal, don't drift.
normal.cn: 要成交（sale）别漂流（sail）：把单子定下来。

abstract.en: See a red price tag falling like a leaf.
abstract.cn: 看红色价签如落叶般下调。

abstract.en: Hear the till drawer shoot open at closing time.
abstract.cn: 听打烊时收银抽屉「唰」地弹开。

abstract.en: Picture a queue outside a shop before dawn on sale day.
abstract.cn: 想象大减价当天黎明前店门口的长队。

examples.en: The sale of the company was completed last week.
examples.cn: 公司出售事宜上周完成。

examples.en: I got these boots in the summer sale.
examples.cn: 这双靴子是我在夏季大减价时买的。

examples.en: Online sales now exceed store sales.
examples.cn: 线上销售额如今已超过线下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「随哦」——大减价随开随抢，手慢无；sale 读音近似「随哦」

root: 源自日耳曼语词根 *sal-（交货换酬），古英语 salu 与 sellan（卖）同根；出售行为之名先后延展为降价活动与销售总额。

sensesIntro.en: Sale moves from the act of selling, to discount events, to total amounts sold, to goods waiting for buyers.
sensesIntro.cn: sale 从出售行为出发，到大减价、销售总额，再到待售的商品本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: goods and money changing hands
core.cn: 核心意象：一手交钱、一手交货

branches.en: The exchange itself is the base image.
branches.cn: 交易行为本身是这个词的基础画面。

branches.en: Selling fast becomes selling cheap.
branches.cn: 「卖得快」演变为「卖得贱」。

branches.en: Many acts of sale add up to the sales figure.
branches.cn: 一次次出售累积成销售数字。

branches.en: A for-sale tag is the first moment of any sale.
branches.cn: 「待售」标签是每笔交易的第一步。

branches.en: Salesmen live where the tag meets the buyer.
branches.cn: 推销员就守在价签与买主之间。

intro.en: Sale builds compounds around shops, signs, and figures.
intro.cn: sale 的构词围绕店铺、标牌与数字展开。

latinIntro.en: Sale is a Germanic word without Latin relatives, so no Latin entries are listed.
latinIntro.cn: sale 属日耳曼语源词，没有拉丁同族词，故不列拉丁词条。

items.example: The old car is for sale.
items.exampleCN: 那辆旧车正在出售。

items.meaning: offered at a lower price; available in shops
items.example: These coats are on sale until Sunday.
items.exampleCN: 这些外套降价销售至周日。

items.example: The salesman showed us three models.
items.exampleCN: 推销员给我们展示了三款型号。

items.example: The sales figures surprised everyone.
items.exampleCN: 销售数据出乎所有人意料。

items.meaning: a sale to empty the stock
items.example: Everything must go in the clearance sale.
items.exampleCN: 清仓甩卖，商品全部出清。

items.meaning: the place where a purchase is completed
items.example: Displays at the point of sale boost impulse buys.
items.exampleCN: 收银台旁的陈列能促进冲动消费。

items.example: He made three sales before lunch.
items.exampleCN: 他午饭前做成了三单生意。

items.meaning: the amount a seller must sell
items.example: She beat her sales target twice this year.
items.exampleCN: 今年她两次超额完成销售指标。

items.meaning: a home sale of used goods
items.example: We found a lamp at the garage sale.
items.exampleCN: 我们在车库旧货摊上淘到一盏灯。

items.meaning: a room where goods are auctioned or sold
items.example: The paintings were shown in the salesroom.
items.exampleCN: 画作在拍卖厅里预展。
